sum: This study develops a rate-and-state friction spring-slider model to investigate the slip stability of gouge-filled faults under dry, fluid-saturated, and fluid-injection conditions. By incorporating gouge dilatancy/compaction and pore pressure evolution, the model shows that fluid saturation without injection delays instability due to dilatancy hardening. Conversely, rapid fluid injection triggers earlier dynamic slip and higher peak slip rates. The paper identifies a transition from a dilatancy-influenced to an injection-dominated nucleation regime governed by an injection-dilatancy competition number. Linear stability analysis defines a generalized critical stiffness incorporating effective normal stress, pressurization rate, and dilatancy feedback, framing injection-induced seismicity as an injection-rate-driven stability problem.

sum: This Nature News & Views article highlights a groundbreaking sea-floor monitoring experiment that successfully captured the creation of oceanic crust between two tectonic plates. Representing the first in situ measurement of sea-floor spreading, the study utilizes advanced undersea observatory instrumentation to record real-time geodynamical and tectonic processes at a mid-ocean ridge, providing unprecedented insights into how the ocean floor forms.
这篇发表在《Nature》的“新闻与观点”文章介绍了一项突破性的海底监测实验，该实验首次原位观测并记录了两大板块之间海洋地壳的诞生。该研究利用先进的海底观测站仪器，实时记录了洋中脊处的地质与构造活动，为理解海底扩张和洋壳形成机制提供了前所未有的直接观测证据。

sum: This paper presents a novel Tree-structured Bayesian Optimization (TBO) method integrated with Helmert Variance Component Estimation (HVCE) to jointly invert fault geometry and slip distribution from geodetic data (GNSS and InSAR). Traditional Monte Carlo-based Bayesian methods suffer from low computational efficiency and high sensitivity to initial parameters. The proposed TBO-HVCE framework overcomes these limitations, offering stable performance, reduced sensitivity to initial conditions, and lower misfits. Synthetic tests across various fault types and multi-fault scenarios demonstrate its robustness. The method is successfully applied to the 2021 Mw 6.4 Yangbi earthquake in Yunnan, China, accurately recovering fault kinematics and surface deformation.
本文提出了一种结合赫尔默特方差分量估计（HVCE）的树状结构贝叶斯优化（TBO）新方法，用于利用大地测量数据（GNSS和InSAR）联合反演断层几何和滑动分布。传统的蒙特卡洛贝叶斯方法计算效率低且对初始参数敏感。该研究提出的TBO-HVCE框架克服了这些局限性，具有更高的计算效率、更低的初始条件敏感……

Synthetic datasets representing various fault types and multi-fault scenarios, alongside real GNSS and InSAR observations of the 2021 Mw 6.4 Yangbi earthquake.

sum: This study presents high-resolution geochemical data and modeling of a 3.13–3.10 Ga volcanic succession in Australia's Pilbara Craton. The sequence contains tholeiitic, calc-alkaline, and boninitic lavas, indicating diverse mantle sources. Geochemical modeling shows that the mantle source required high water content, approaching modern mantle wedges. The authors propose that this hydrous melting was triggered by 'dripduction'—the localized, inclined foundering of hydrated lithosphere—rather than modern-style global plate tectonics.

sum: This study addresses a key design tension in deep-learning-based seismic phase picking for borehole and DAS arrays: whether array-level models (which exploit coherent moveout across depth-ordered stations) generalize better to unseen sites than per-trace models (which treat stations independently). Using a rigorous leave-one-site-out benchmarking framework, the author evaluates how spatial aperture, station spacing, and source-array configurations affect model extrapolation. The work provides critical insights into whether coupling deep learning models to array geometry helps or hurts phase-picking performance on unseen high-frequency borehole monitoring networks.
本研究探讨了井下和DAS台阵深度学习震相拾取中的核心设计冲突：利用台阵内部相干走时差（moveout）的台阵级模型，与独立处理各台站的单通道模型相比，在未见站点上的泛化能力孰优孰劣。作者采用严格的“留一站点”基准测试框架，评估了空间孔径、台站间距及震源-台阵几何分布对模型外推性能的影响。该研究为深度……

sum: This study presents 3-m-resolution surface displacement and slip distributions for the 2023 Mw 7.8 Pazarcık and Mw 7.5 Elbistan, Türkiye, earthquakes using subpixel correlation of Planet Dove optical imagery. Focusing on a 30-km-long region spanning the Narlı-East Anatolian fault (EAF) intersection, the authors compare slip measurements from five datasets of varying resolutions (on-the-ground, WorldView, Planet Dove, Sentinel-2, and Sentinel-1). By integrating these surface observations with dynamic rupture simulations, they constrain the rupture evolution of the Pazarcık earthquake, which nucleated on the Narlı splay fault before propagating bilaterally onto the EAF. The work demonstrates how high-resolution surface deformation data from splay faults can resolve nonunique rupture models and improve our understanding of complex earthquake physics.
本研究利用Planet Dove光学影像的亚像素相关性，获取了2023年土耳其Mw 7.8 Pazarcık和Mw 7.5 Elbistan地震的3米分辨率地表形变及滑移分布。针对跨越Narlı与东安纳托利亚断裂（EAF）交汇处30公里的研究区，对比了野外、WorldView、Planet Dove……

sum: This paper by Marco Bohnhoff, published as a Viewpoint in Geophysical Journal International, re-evaluates the seismotectonic complexity and seismic hazard of the Main Marmara Fault (MMF) in the Istanbul-Marmara region. Given its proximity to the megacity of Istanbul, understanding the segmentation, locking state, and potential rupture scenarios of the MMF is critical for seismic risk mitigation. The paper synthesizes recent seismological, geodetic, and geological observations to challenge simplified single-segment rupture models, advocating for a more nuanced understanding of the fault's structural heterogeneity and its implications for strong ground motion and hazard assessment.

sum: This study utilizes high-resolution microseismic monitoring to investigate the progressive activation of a complex fault system during hydraulic fracturing operations. By analyzing high-precision microseismic locations and source parameters, the authors track the spatial-temporal evolution of seismicity and fluid migration. The results demonstrate how fluid injection progressively triggers slip on pre-existing complex fault networks, providing critical insights into the physical mechanisms of injection-induced earthquakes and fault reactivation.

sum: This paper presents a theoretical framework using stationary-phase analysis to evaluate the reconstruction of nonballistic (scattered) waves in stacked ambient noise cross-correlation functions (XCFs). While ballistic wave reconstruction is well understood, scattered wave reconstruction remains challenging. The authors derive analytical stationary-phase solutions to establish the mathematical and physical conditions required for accurate scattered wave retrieval. They quantify crosstalk artifacts arising from overlapping random noise sources, which can be indistinguishable from true coda waves generated by medium scatterers. This ambiguity highlights the need for additional constraints when interpreting late-arriving coda in XCFs. When source effects are suppressed, these solutions provide a rigorous foundation for extracting deterministic scattering information for high-resolution passive seismic imaging and monitoring.

sum: This paper presents a GPU-accelerated 3D finite-difference method to simulate dipole-source acoustic wave propagation in deviated boreholes within vertically transversely isotropic (VTI) formations. By employing a coordinate system rotation strategy, the method efficiently handles anisotropy with high computational performance. Simulations on a 2x2x6 m wellbore model (e.g., Pierre Shale) reveal distinct shear-wave velocity variations and splitting in the xoz and yoz planes as well deviation increases. Slowness-time-coherence analysis validates the simulated velocities against theoretical group velocities. The study demonstrates that well deviations exceeding 60 degrees introduce significant amplitude and arrival-time differences between fast and slow shear waves, enhancing the interpretation of acoustic logging in complex anisotropic reservoirs.

sum: This study applies a non-parametric Generalized Inversion Technique (GIT) to Fourier amplitude spectra of 735 earthquakes (ML 1.65–4.55) recorded between 2016 and 2024 in the European Southeastern Alps. By separating source, path, and site effects, the authors map spatial variations in stress drop and Savage-Wood seismic efficiency across the Adriatic indenter. Key findings include a general increase in stress drop with depth, deviations from self-similar scaling (apparent stress increases with event size), and distinct spatial patterns of seismic efficiency. High-efficiency events concentrate in the northeastern Italian Alps and Snežnik Mt., while lower-efficiency events align with the Tolmin-Idrija and Gemona-Tarcento fault systems, providing new mechanical constraints for regional seismic hazard assessment.

sum: This study utilizes receiver function analysis to provide the first regional-scale estimate of subducted oceanic plate crustal thickness along the Perú-Chile Subduction Zone (10°S to 40°S) at depths up to ~100 km. The results show that the subducting Nazca plate crust varies in thickness from 6 to 22 km, with the thickest crust occurring near subducting aseismic ridges (e.g., the Nazca Ridge). Notably, flat-slab segments exhibit a broader zone of crustal thickening than predicted by offshore ridge geometry. Comparing these observations with numerical models suggests that while the combined effect of plate age and crustal thickness controls slab buoyancy and dip, a wide zone of crustal thickening (>400 km) is essential for supporting flat-slab subduction.

sum: This study investigates the deep circulation of meteoric water in the Himalayas and its relationship with regional tectonics and seismicity. By analyzing stable isotopes (δ18O and δD) and water chemistry of hot springs across three major tectonic boundaries, and integrating geothermometry-derived reservoir temperatures with earthquake hypocentral depths, the authors find that the maximum depth of meteoric water circulation is ~3–5 km. This is shallower than the regional earthquake hypocenters (5–25 km). The circulation is deeper in extensional settings or near additional heat sources, and shallower in compressional settings unless thrust faults are tectonically active. The study concludes that meteoric water circulation depths are strongly controlled by subsurface tectonic structures and fault activity, and generally do not reach earthquake hypocentral depths.

sum: This study investigates the geometry and kinematics of active seismogenic structures in the Val d'Agri region (Southern Italy) using a high-resolution microseismic catalog. The authors apply waveform similarity-based clustering, high-quality earthquake relocation, and moment tensor inversion for events with M > 2. The relocated seismicity delineates planar, steeply southwest-dipping fault segments, consistent with the regional extensional stress regime. Additionally, the spatio-temporal evolution of a specific seismic sequence is analyzed, and scenario-based finite-fault ground-motion simulations are performed to constrain potential ground-motion variability. The novelty lies in combining high-resolution microseismic clustering with physics-based ground-motion simulations to characterize active faulting in a complex tectonic-anthropogenic setting.

sum: This study jointly inverts Rayleigh wave dispersion and receiver function data to constrain the crustal and uppermost mantle structures beneath the Hangai Dome in central Mongolia. The results reveal a significantly thickened crust (50–53 km) and thinned lithosphere (65–70 km). A low-velocity zone in the lower crust beneath the eastern Hangai Dome suggests the presence of fluids and volatiles, facilitating the ascent of mantle-derived melts. Strong linear correlations between surface elevation, crustal thickness, and Bouguer gravity anomalies indicate near-isostatic equilibrium. The findings demonstrate that inherited crustal thickening is the primary driver of the Hangai Dome's surface uplift, while asthenospheric upwelling plays a secondary role.

sum: This paper introduces Flow Matching, a generative AI technique, to the domain of probabilistic geophysical inversion. The authors adapt the mathematical framework of Flow Matching to reconstruct posterior probability distributions for seismic velocity models. The method is evaluated using two synthetic case studies: a simple 2D velocity model to demonstrate the fundamental characteristics of the approach, and the OpenFWI dataset to showcase its capability in handling complex seismic velocity structures. The approach offers a new generative modeling paradigm for uncertainty quantification in full-waveform inversion.

sum: This study proposes an on-site comparison calibration system for broadband seismometers that incorporates temperature correction to mitigate sensitivity changes in the reference seismometer. The system was applied to calibrate operational STS-1 seismometers, determining midband sensitivity around 0.5 Hz with low uncertainties of 0.3%–0.5%. It also identified an unexpected 28 ms time delay and mapped the relative frequency response down to 0.02 Hz, demonstrating a robust approach for seismic network quality control.

sum: This study identifies and analyzes four rare intermediate-depth reverse polarity earthquake families within a catalog of 3,153 repeating earthquake sequences in the North Chilean subduction zone (2006–2024). Focusing on the largest cluster of 38 events (including 5 reverse events), the authors use relative relocations and cluster analysis to constrain the active volume to a few hundred meters. The overlapping ruptures and weak upward migration over years suggest that these nearly reversed focal mechanisms are driven by transient processes, potentially linked to dehydration embrittlement and fluid pulses.
本研究在2006至2024年智利北部俯冲带的3153个重复地震序列目录中，识别并分析了四个罕见的中源反极性地震家族。通过对包含38个事件（含5个反向事件）的最大微震群进行相对重定位和聚类特征分析，研究人员将活动破裂体积限制在仅数百米范围内。破裂区的重叠以及多年来微弱的向上迁移特征表明，这些近乎相反的……

利用重复地震序列的相对重定位和聚类特征分析，识别时空演化模式与波形极性反转。
Seismic catalog of 3,153 repeating earthquake sequences in the North Chilean subduction zone recorded from 2006 to 2024.
使用2006至2024年间智利北部俯冲带记录的包含3,153个重复地震序列的地震目录。
Identification of four reverse polarity families, with the largest containing 38 events (5 reverse) within a small active volume of a few hundred meters.

sum: This study systematically analyzes 1,175 small-to-moderate aftershocks of the 2018 Mw 7.9 Gulf of Alaska outer-rise earthquake using data from the AACSE network. By applying a spectral decomposition approach to P waves and assuming a Brune source model, the authors estimate earthquake source spectra and stress drops. The results show that stress drop is independent of magnitude, supporting self-similar scaling. However, a strong depth dependence is observed, with median stress drops at depths >25 km being three times higher than those at <25 km. Lateral variations in stress drop are only present within the 12–25 km depth range. These findings suggest that bending-related stresses and depth-dependent mechanical properties govern stress-drop heterogeneity in outer-rise settings.
本研究利用AACSE台网数据，系统分析了2018年Mw 7.9阿拉斯加湾外隆起地震的1175个中小余震。通过对P波应用谱分解方法并采用Brune源模型，估算了地震震源谱和应力降。结果表明，应力降与震级无系统相关性，符合自相似标度关系。然而，应力降表现出明显的深度依赖性，深部（>25 km）的应力降中……

Waveform data from 1,175 small-to-moderate aftershocks of the 2018 Mw 7.9 Gulf of Alaska earthquake, recorded by the onshore-offshore AACSE network from May 2018 to September 2019.

sum: This paper proposes a physical and statistical framework for predicting large earthquakes based on the hypothesis that gravity-driven crustal displacement drives seismicity. By applying Noether's theorems, the author links earthquake frequency to crustal energy states and structural variations. The study introduces a method to calculate earthquake probability by analyzing deviations of cumulative earthquake counts from linearity, alongside a 'tau' rule that incorporates both seismic quiescent and active periods. Retrospective validation shows improved temporal prediction accuracy compared to simple periodic models. Finally, regional probability calculations are applied to assess future large earthquake hazards in central mainland China.
该研究基于重力驱动地壳位移引发地震的假设，结合诺特定理阐明了大震发生频率与地壳能量状态及结构变化的定量关系。通过分析累积地震数偏离时间线性关系的特征，构建了大震发生概率计算方法，并提出综合考虑地震活跃期与平静期的“τ”规则预测大震时间。回顾性检验表明，该方法的时间预测精度显著优于传统周期法，并初步应……

Historical regional earthquake catalogs used for retrospective validation and spatial dependency analysis in central mainland China.

sum: This study investigates the rupture kinematics of the 2023 Kahramanmaraş, Türkiye earthquake doublet (Mw 7.8 and Mw 7.7) by integrating teleseismic backprojection imaging and joint finite-fault inversion. The authors reveal distinct rupture propagation patterns controlled by fault geometry. The first Mw 7.8 event originated on a splay fault and transitioned from subshear to transient supershear ruptures after passing through fault bends along the East Anatolian Fault (EAF). In contrast, the subsequent Mw 7.7 event initiated on a simpler fault strand and propagated bilaterally at a persistent supershear velocity. The findings highlight that geometric complexity is a key factor modulating large-scale earthquake rupture velocities.
本研究结合远震回溯投影成像和联合有限断层反演，系统分析了2023年土耳其卡赫拉曼马拉什双震（Mw 7.8和Mw 7.7）的破裂运动学特征。研究表明，复杂的断层几何结构直接控制了两者不同的破裂传播模式：Mw 7.8地震始于支断层，在穿过东安纳托利亚断裂带弯折处后发生了三次瞬态超剪切破裂；而Mw 7.7……

sum: This study discovers tidally modulated tremor at the Gofar transform fault along the East Pacific Rise. By analyzing tremor amplitudes, tidal phases, and temporal variations in the Vp/Vs ratio, the authors identify a valve-like sealing-drainage dynamic process. During periods of low Vp/Vs and sparse seismicity, hydrothermal sealing traps magmatic volatiles, boosting tidal sensitivity and sustaining tremor. Subsequent earthquake swarms and ruptures open high-permeability pathways, releasing fluids, silencing tremors, and triggering microseismicity before hydrothermal healing resets the cycle. This reveals that oceanic transform faults are highly permeable, tide-critical systems where energy release oscillates between tremor and rupture.

sum: This article presents the priorities and development plan for a next-generation Community Velocity Model (CVM) for the Cascadia Subduction Zone (CSZ), formulated by the CRESCENT working group and regional partners. The proposed model will span from the surface to ~100 km depth, covering offshore and onshore regions from Idaho to the tectonic transitions in California and Canada. Key priorities include implementing FAIR data principles, capturing along-strike and along-dip structural heterogeneity, resolving shallow offshore-onshore structures, and quantifying elastic property uncertainties. This model will serve as a critical foundation for numerical wave propagation, earthquake ground-motion simulations, and tsunami hazard assessments in the Pacific Northwest.
本文介绍了由CRESCENT社区速度模型工作组及合作伙伴制定的卡斯卡迪亚俯冲带（CSZ）下一代社区速度模型（CVM）的发展规划与科学重点。该模型范围从地表至约100公里深度，横跨陆地与海洋。其核心任务包括实现FAIR数据准则、刻画沿走向和倾向的结构非均匀性、解析浅部海陆过渡带结构，并量化弹性参数的不……

sum: This paper introduces Geo-Strat-RL, a synthetic environment designed to train and evaluate vision-language models (VLMs) on geological event reconstruction. Reconstructing geological histories from visual patterns is challenging due to temporal and structural ambiguities. To address this, the authors employ Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), utilizing an executable verifier that scores chronology, event identity, deposition, and structural relationships. The method improves VLM reconstruction performance on stratigraphic diagrams. Crucially, the study demonstrates that geological reasoning learned from stratigraphic diagrams successfully transfers to synthetic seismic amplitude sections (derived from acoustic impedance) without seismic-specific training, showing that RLVR can teach generalizable geological concepts.

sum: This paper presents the DETECT seismological dataset, which consists of continuous recordings from 200 temporary stations (seismic network ZK) operating for approximately one year (August 2021 to August 2022) in the Southern Apennines, Italy. The experiment deployed 20 dense seismic arrays (each with a ~2 km aperture, containing broadband, short-period, and geophone sensors) directly above the fault segments of the destructive 1980 M 6.9 Irpinia earthquake. The resulting 5.2 TB dataset is fully compliant with FDSN standards and managed via SeisComP. It provides high-resolution observations to study microseismicity, fault-zone properties, and seismic hazard in one of Italy's most active tectonic regions.

sum: This study investigates how fluid pre-conditioning (FP) affects the reactivation and nucleation of a critically stressed laboratory fault in Rotondo granite under fluid pressurization. Using distributed strain sensing (DSS) with optical fibers and piezoelectric transducers, the authors monitored deformation, P-wave velocity variations, and acoustic emissions. They found that FP leads to a smoother, more spatially distributed reduction in effective normal stress, resembling a drained response. In contrast, non-pre-conditioned tests exhibit a locally undrained response with strong effective-stress gradients, promoting slip barriers and complex nucleation. The novelty lies in demonstrating that injection-driven reactivation is governed by the pre-established spatiotemporal distribution of permeability and effective stress, rather than just pore-pressure magnitude.

sum: This study analyzes a long-lived, rain-induced earthquake swarm in Palghar, western India, containing ~8,300 well-located events (M -0.1 to 4.6) from January 2019 to November 2020. By dividing the swarm into seasonal phases, the authors identify distinct physical mechanisms. Monsoon-end phases exhibit high b-values and low seismic moments, indicating fluid-driven cataclastic deformation. Conversely, dry seasons show low b-values and high seismic moments, characteristic of stick-slip motion. The co-existence of mainshock-aftershock sequences driven by stress triggering alongside fluid diffusion explains the swarm's unusual longevity, marking the first report of multiple interacting causal mechanisms in a rain-induced swarm.

sum: This study addresses the origin of the lower seismic layer (LSL) in double seismic zones (DSZs) within subducting oceanic lithosphere. By combining geophysical observations with geodynamic numerical modeling, the authors demonstrate that melt crystallization and subsequent metamorphic reactions within the mid-lithospheric discontinuity (MLD) promote grain-size reduction and rheological layering. This layering localizes differential stress in the mantle section above the MLD, creating favorable conditions for earthquake generation. Crucially, this proposed mechanism explains the development of the LSL without requiring a hydrated mantle, aligning with seismic observations from various global subduction zones.
本研究探讨了俯冲大洋岩石圈双地震带（DSZ）中下地震层（LSL）的成因。作者结合地球物理观测与地球动力学数值模拟，表明中岩石圈不连续面（MLD）内的熔体结晶及随后的变质反应促进了细粒化和流变分层。这种分层在MLD上方的地幔区域内造成了剪切应力集中，为地震发生创造了有利条件。该机制的创新之处在于不需要……

t: Geodynamic numerical modeling combined with rheological and metamorphic reaction formulations to simulate lithospheric deformation.
结合流变学和变质反应公式的地球动力学数值模拟，用以模拟岩石圈变形。
Synthetic data from geodynamic simulations constrained by global geophysical observations of double seismic zones and mid-lithospheric discontinuities.
由全球双地震带和中岩石圈不连续面地球物理观测约束的地球动力学模拟合成数据。
Melt crystallization in the MLD localizes differential stress in the mantle above it, explaining LSL seismicity without requiring hydration.
MLD中的熔体结晶使其上方地幔产生差应力集中，解释了无需水化的下地震层地震活动。
The model's simplified representation of complex metamorphic reactions and 3D slab geometries.
模型对复杂的变质反应和三维板块几何形状进行了简化处理。
Linking the lower seismic layer of DSZs to dry rheological layering from MLDs rather than mantle hydration.
将双地震带的下地震层与MLD引起的干性流变分层联系起来，而非地幔水化作用。

kc: Proposed a genetic link between the oceanic mid-lithospheric discontinuity (MLD) and the lower seismic layer (LSL) of double seismic zones.
Demonstrated through geodynamic modeling that melt crystallization and metamorphic reactions in the MLD cause grain-size reduction and rheological layering.
Provided a physical mechanism for DSZ generation that does not rely on mantle hydration, resolving discrepancies with dry seismic observations.
提出了大洋中岩石圈不连续面（MLD）与双地震带下地震层（LSL）之间的成因联系。
通过地球动力学模拟证实，MLD内的熔体结晶和变质反应会导致晶粒细化和流变分层。
提供了一种不依赖于地幔水化的双地震带产生物理机制，解决了与干性地震观测结果之间的矛盾。
me: Geodynamic numerical modeling of subducting oceanic lithosphere.
Integration of geophysical observational constraints on mid-lithospheric discontinuities (MLD) and double seismic zones (DSZs).
Rheological and metamorphic reaction modeling to simulate grain-size reduction and stress localization.
俯冲大洋岩石圈的地球动力学数值模拟。
整合关于中岩石圈不连续面（MLD）和双地震带（DSZ）的地球物理观测约束。
流变学和变质反应模拟，以模拟晶粒细化和应力集中过程。
de: Numerical experiments simulating the subduction of rheologically layered oceanic lithosphere containing an MLD.
Comparison of model stress profiles with global seismic observations of double seismic zones.
模拟包含MLD的流变分层大洋岩石圈俯冲过程的数值实验。
将模型应力剖面与全球双地震带的地震观测数据进行对比。
li: The study relies on simplified geodynamic models which may not capture the full 3D complexity of all subduction zones.
The exact mineralogical and chemical composition of the MLD remains subject to observational uncertainties.
该研究依赖于简化的地球动力学模型，可能无法完全捕捉所有俯冲带的三维复杂性。
MLD的具体矿物学和化学成分仍存在观测上的不确定性。

tm.why: The paper investigates the origin and generation mechanisms of earthquakes within the lower seismic layer of double seismic zones.
It links double seismic zones to the rheological layering and mid-lithospheric discontinuities of the oceanic lithosphere using geodynamic modeling.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata available on EarthArXiv and OpenAlex, as no full PDF was accessible.

sum: This Zenodo repository contains the complete dataset and Python code supporting the paper 'Low frequency icequakes generated during transient cavity drainage on a Greenlandic outlet glacier'. The resources include downsampled MSEED seismic waveforms, GNSS displacement data, matched-filter processing (MFP) localization catalogs for low-frequency events (1.5-21 Hz and 4-6 Hz), hydraulic potential maps, and correlated event families for both surface and deep icequake sources. These data enable the reproduction of the paper's figures and facilitate further research into subglacial hydrology and cryoseismology.
该Zenodo仓库包含了支持“格陵兰外流冰川瞬态空腔排水期间产生的低频冰震”论文的完整数据集和Python代码。资源包括降采样的MSEED地震波形、GNSS位移数据、低频事件（1.5-21 Hz和4-6 Hz）的匹配滤波处理（MFP）定位目录、水力势图以及地表和深部冰震源的关联事件族。这些数据可用于……

t: Matched-filter processing (MFP) and correlation analysis are used to locate and classify low-frequency icequakes into surface and deep families.
采用匹配滤波处理（MFP）和关联分析对低频冰震进行定位并分类为地表和深部族群。
Seismic waveforms downsampled to 200 Hz, GNSS data, ice thickness kriging maps, and hydraulic potential geotiffs from a Greenlandic glacier.
包含格陵兰冰川降采样至200 Hz的地震波形、GNSS数据、冰川厚度图及水力势数据。
The dataset provides localized event catalogs and correlated families that map the spatial-temporal evolution of icequakes during cavity drainage.
提供了定位事件目录和关联事件族，展示了空腔排水期间冰震的时空演化。
The seismic data is downsampled to 200 Hz and covers a short temporal window (September 10-12, 2024).
地震数据降采样至200 Hz，且时间跨度较短（2024年9月10日至12日）。
A comprehensive, open-access multi-disciplinary dataset linking seismic, geodetic, and hydraulic observations of transient subglacial drainage events.
提供了一个将地震、大地测量和水力学观测相结合的开源多学科冰川排水数据集。

kc: Provides downsampled multi-station seismic waveform data (MSEED) capturing transient subglacial drainage events.
Includes localized icequake catalogs categorized by frequency bands and source depths (surface vs. deep).
Shares Python scripts to fully reproduce the main figures of the associated scientific paper.
提供了捕获瞬态冰下排水事件的降采样多台站地震波形数据（MSEED）。
包含了按频段和震源深度（地表与深部）分类的定位冰震目录。
共享了用于完全重现相关科学论文主要插图的 Python 脚本。
me: Matched-filter processing (MFP) for spatial localization of low-frequency icequake events.
Correlation analysis to group icequakes into distinct surface and deep event families.
Hydraulic potential modeling to map subglacial water routing.
用于低频冰震事件空间定位的匹配滤波处理（MFP）方法。
将冰震分组为不同地表和深部事件族的关联分析。
用于绘制冰下水流路径的水力势建模。
de: Seismic waveform data from temporary seismic nodes downsampled to 200 Hz.
GNSS time-series data tracking ice surface displacement.
Kriged ice thickness maps and hydraulic potential geotiff files.
降采样至 200 Hz 的临时地震节点地震波形数据。
追踪冰面位移的 GNSS 时间序列数据。
克里金插值的冰川厚度图和水力势 geotiff 文件。
li: The seismic data is downsampled to 200 Hz, which may limit high-frequency micro-crack analysis.
The dataset is temporally restricted to a specific drainage window in September 2024.
地震数据被降采样至 200 Hz，这可能会限制高频微裂隙分析。
数据集在时间上局限于 2024 年 9 月的特定排水窗口。

tm.why: The dataset and code are designed to study low-frequency icequakes generated during transient cavity drainage on a Greenlandic outlet glacier.
The resources include matched-filter processing (MFP) localizations and catalogs of correlated surface and deep icequake families.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the detailed Zenodo repository abstract and file list, as no PDF was available.

sum: This study investigates extensive deep-seated igneous intrusions within the crystalline basement of the Baltic Basin (SW East European Craton, Poland) using high-resolution regional seismic profiles from the PolandSPAN® survey. Located at depths of 6–20 km, these intrusions are imaged as strong, sometimes saucer-shaped, seismic reflectors. To constrain their properties beyond borehole reach, the authors combine quantitative seismic resolution assessment and tuning thickness estimation with 2D seismic forward modeling. They conclude that these features are likely doleritic sills, 60 to 200 m thick, belonging to the Mississippian Lublin-Baltic Igneous Province. This integrated workflow provides a robust framework for characterizing deep magmatic systems globally.
本研究利用PolandSPAN®高分辨率区域地震剖面，对波罗的海盆地（波兰东欧克拉通西南缘）结晶基底内深达6-20公里的深部火成岩侵入体进行了探测。这些侵入体在地震剖面上表现为强反射界面，呈碟形或阶梯状。由于超出了钻孔探测深度，研究结合地震分辨率定量评估、调谐厚度计算与二维地震正演模拟，推断其为厚度……

t: Integration of regional seismic reflection interpretation with 2D seismic forward modeling and tuning thickness analysis to constrain sub-resolution sill properties.
结合区域反射地震解释、二维地震正演模拟和调谐厚度分析，约束亚波长尺度的岩床属性。
Deep, high-resolution regional-scale active-source seismic reflection profiles from the PolandSPAN® survey crossing the Baltic Basin.
横跨波罗的海盆地的PolandSPAN®调查深部、高分辨率区域尺度主动源反射地震剖面。
Identification of 60–200 m thick doleritic intrusions at depths of 6–20 km, extending over 100 km laterally within the crystalline basement.
在结晶基底6-20公里深度处，识别出厚度为60-200米、横向延伸超100公里的辉绿岩侵入体。
Lack of direct borehole calibration at great depths (6–20 km) requires reliance on seismic properties and forward modeling.
深部（6-20公里）缺乏直接的钻孔校准，必须依赖地震属性和正演模拟。
First detailed seismic characterization and forward modeling of the deep Mississippian Lublin-Baltic Igneous Province within the East European Craton basement.
首次对东欧克拉通基底内深部密西西比纪鲁布林-波罗的海火成岩省进行详细的地震表征与正演模拟。

kc: Imaged extensive deep-seated igneous intrusions (6–20 km depth) within the Baltic Basin crystalline basement using PolandSPAN® seismic data.
Developed an integrated workflow combining seismic resolution analysis, tuning thickness estimation, and 2D seismic forward modeling.
Identified the intrusions as likely doleritic sills with thicknesses ranging from 60 to 200 m, linking them to the Mississippian Lublin-Baltic Igneous Province.
利用PolandSPAN®地震数据，对波罗的海盆地结晶基底深部（6-20公里深度）的广泛火成岩侵入体进行了成像。
开发了结合地震分辨率分析、调谐厚度估算和二维地震正演模拟的综合工作流。
确定侵入体极可能为厚度在60至200米之间的辉绿岩床，并将其归属于密西西比纪鲁布林-波罗的海火成岩省。
me: Seismic reflection interpretation of regional-scale high-resolution profiles.
2D seismic forward modeling based on geological and petrophysical constraints.
Quantitative assessment of seismic resolution and tuning thickness.
区域尺度高分辨率剖面的反射地震解释。
基于地质和岩石物理约束的二维地震正演模拟。
地震分辨率与调谐厚度的定量评估。
de: Deep, high-resolution regional-scale seismic reflection profiles from the PolandSPAN® survey.
Synthetic seismic models generated to test different lithologies, geometries, and thicknesses of the sills.
来自PolandSPAN®调查的深部、高分辨率区域尺度反射地震剖面。
用于测试岩床不同岩性、几何形状和厚度的合成地震正演模型。
li: The target intrusions are far beyond the reach of physical borehole samples, making lithological interpretations indirect and dependent on forward modeling assumptions.
目标侵入体远超钻孔物理取样深度，使得岩性解释具有间接性，且依赖于正演模拟的假设。

tm.why: The paper investigates deep igneous intrusions within the crystalline basement of the Baltic Basin at depths of 6 to 20 km using seismic data.
The paper utilizes 2D seismic forward modeling to constrain the lithology, thickness, and geometry of the deep intrusions.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata from Copernicus/Solid Earth and Semantic Scholar.

sum: This study evaluates the capability of Differential Interferometric Synthetic Aperture Radar (DInSAR) to detect weak surface deformation from small-magnitude (M < 5) events, focusing on the 2023 ML 4.4 Umbertide extensional earthquake in Central Italy. By inverting Sentinel-1 displacement maps from the EPOS platform using a linear Bayesian static slip inversion, and constraining the geometry with nodal planes and relocated seismicity, the authors show that the earthquake activated a NE-dipping splay of the Alto Tiberina Fault. The deformation corresponds to 2 cm of vertical and 1.5 cm of eastward horizontal displacement, demonstrating that integrated InSAR approaches can successfully model frequent, small-magnitude earthquakes in high-hazard regions.
本研究评估了微分干涉雷达（DInSAR）检测小震级（M < 5）地表微弱形变的能力。研究针对2023年意大利中部ML 4.4翁贝尔蒂德正断层地震，利用EPOS平台的Sentinel-1形变图，结合震源机制解和重定位余震约束，进行了线性贝叶斯静态滑动反演。结果表明，该地震激活了Alto Tiberin……

t: Linear Bayesian static slip inversion of Sentinel-1 DInSAR line-of-sight displacement data, with fault geometry constrained by nodal planes and relocated seismicity.
对Sentinel-1 DInSAR视线向位移数据进行线性贝叶斯静态滑动反演，并结合震源机制和重定位地震约束几何。
Sentinel-1 DInSAR displacement maps from the European Plate Observing System (EPOS) platform and relocated earthquake catalog data.
使用来自欧洲板块观测系统（EPOS）平台的Sentinel-1 DInSAR位移图及重定位地震目录。
The earthquake activated the NE-dipping splay of the Alto Tiberina Fault, producing 2 cm of vertical and 1.5 cm of eastward horizontal deformation.
地震激活了Alto Tiberina断裂向东北倾斜的羽状分支，造成2厘米垂直和1.5厘米向东的水平形变。
Detecting and modeling weak deformation from small-magnitude (M < 5) events is challenging due to low signal-to-noise ratios.
由于信噪比较低，检测和模拟小震级（M < 5）事件产生的微弱形变具有挑战性。
Demonstrates that integrated InSAR-based Bayesian modeling can successfully resolve finite fault slip and weak deformation for earthquakes as small as ML 4.4.
证明了集成的InSAR贝叶斯建模方法能够成功解析低至ML 4.4小地震的有限断层滑动与微弱形变。

kc: Demonstrated the capability of DInSAR to resolve weak surface deformation (up to 2 cm) from a small ML 4.4 earthquake.
Identified the active fault segment as the NE-dipping splay of the Alto Tiberina Fault using Bayesian slip inversion.
Integrated satellite geodesy with relocated seismicity to constrain the finite fault model of a minor event.
证明了DInSAR能够解析ML 4.4小地震产生的微弱地表形变（最大达2厘米）。
利用贝叶斯滑动反演确定了发震断层为Alto Tiberina断裂向东北倾斜的羽状分支。
将卫星大地测量学与重定位地震活动性相结合，约束了小震级事件的有限断层模型。
me: Differential Interferometric Synthetic Aperture Radar (DInSAR) processing of Sentinel-1 data.
Linear Bayesian static slip inversion of line-of-sight (LOS) displacement data.
Fault geometry constraint using nodal planes and relocated mainshock/aftershock distributions.
对Sentinel-1数据进行微分干涉合成孔径雷达（DInSAR）处理。
对视线向（LOS）位移数据进行线性贝叶斯静态滑动反演。
利用节面和重定位的主震/余震分布约束断层几何形状。
de: Sentinel-1 displacement maps obtained from the European Plate Observing System (EPOS) platform.
Relocated mainshock and aftershock catalog for the 2023 Umbertide earthquake sequence.
获取自欧洲板块观测系统（EPOS）平台的Sentinel-1位移图。
2023年翁贝尔蒂德地震序列的重定位主震和余震目录。
li: Small-magnitude events produce low signal-to-noise ratio deformation signals, making them highly sensitive to atmospheric noise in InSAR data.
小震级事件产生的形变信号信噪比低，使得反演对InSAR数据中的大气噪声高度敏感。

tm.why: The paper performs a linear Bayesian static slip inversion to model the finite fault source of the 2023 Umbertide earthquake.
The study utilizes a linear Bayesian static slip inversion of DInSAR line-of-sight data to constrain the fault slip.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the peer-reviewed abstract and metadata from Scientific Reports and Semantic Scholar, as no PDF was available.

sum: The authors present SDpy (stress drop in Python), an open-source, modular, and extensible Python package designed for robust earthquake stress-drop estimation. It supports spectral fitting and spectral ratio methods using P, S, and coda waves with single- or multi-window approaches. SDpy incorporates multiple theoretical source models (e.g., Brune and Boatwright) and accommodates diverse processing scenarios, including single- or multi-station data and empirical Green's functions (eGFs). The package's reliability is demonstrated through its application to a repeating earthquake sequence at the San Andreas Fault Observatory at Depth (SAFOD), yielding stress-drop estimates consistent with previous studies.
本文介绍了SDpy，一个用于稳健估计地震应力降的开源Python包。该工具基于谱拟合和谱比值法，支持利用P波、S波及尾波进行单窗口或多窗口分析。SDpy集成了Brune和Boatwright等多种理论震源模型，并能灵活处理单/三分量记录、单/多台站数据以及单/多个经验格林函数（eGF）等多种应用场景……

t: SDpy implements spectral fitting and spectral ratio methods using Brune and Boatwright source models to estimate earthquake stress drops from P, S, and coda waves.
SDpy实现了基于Brune和Boatwright震源模型的谱拟合与谱比值法，可处理P波、S波及尾波。
The package was tested and validated using a repeating earthquake sequence recorded at the San Andreas Fault Observatory at Depth (SAFOD).
该软件包使用圣安德烈斯断层深部观测站（SAFOD）记录的重复地震序列进行了测试和验证。
SDpy successfully reproduced stress-drop estimates for the SAFOD repeating sequence that are highly consistent with previous literature, proving its reliability.
SDpy成功重构了SAFOD重复地震序列的应力降，其结果与前人研究高度一致，证明了其可靠性。
The abstract does not explicitly detail limitations, but performance inherently relies on user-selected empirical Green's functions and signal-to-noise ratios.
摘要未详细说明局限性，但其性能本质上依赖于用户对经验格林函数的选择和信噪比。
SDpy provides a unified, modular, and highly flexible Python-based framework accommodating multiple wave types, windowing approaches, and station configurations.
SDpy提供了一个统一、模块化且高度灵活的Python框架，支持多种波形、窗口和台站配置。

kc: Developed SDpy, a modular and user-friendly open-source Python package for earthquake stress-drop estimation.
Integrated both spectral fitting and spectral ratio methods supporting P, S, and coda waves.
Provided flexibility for various processing scenarios, including single/multi-station data and empirical Green's functions (eGFs).
开发了SDpy，一个用于地震应力降估计的模块化、用户友好的开源Python包。
集成了支持P波、S波和尾波的谱拟合与谱比值方法。
为多种处理场景提供了灵活性，包括单/多台站数据和经验格林函数（eGF）。
me: Spectral fitting method using theoretical source models (Brune and Boatwright models).
Spectral ratio method utilizing empirical Green's functions (eGFs).
Single- and multi-window analysis of P, S, and coda waves.
使用理论震源模型（Brune和Boatwright模型）的谱拟合方法。
利用经验格林函数（eGF）的谱比值法。
对P波、S波和尾波进行单窗口和多窗口分析。
de: Applied the package to a repeating earthquake sequence targeted by the San Andreas Fault Observatory at Depth (SAFOD) to validate its performance.
将该软件包应用于圣安德烈斯断层深部观测站（SAFOD）的重复地震序列，以验证其性能。
li: The accuracy of stress-drop estimation remains dependent on the quality of input waveforms and the selection of appropriate empirical Green's functions.
应力降估计的准确性仍然取决于输入波形的质量以及合适经验格林函数的选择。

tm.why: The paper introduces a Python package specifically designed for estimating earthquake stress drop, which is a key parameter for characterizing earthquake source processes and rupture dynamics.
Stress drop is critical for understanding fault strength and fault mechanics, and the package is applied to SAFOD repeating earthquakes.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata from OpenAlex and Crossref.

sum: This study introduces TremorViT, a novel vision transformer-based deep learning framework designed to locate tectonic tremor sources in three dimensions along with their aleatoric uncertainties using single-station three-component seismic wavefields. Applied to the Nankai subduction zone, TremorViT achieves a mean epicentral error of 4.8 km with a single station, which reduces to 2.5 km when integrating multiple station-level estimates. The authors successfully localized 68,101 tremor events (1135.0 cumulative hours) between January and September 2016. This represents a significantly higher detection sensitivity and temporal resolution than existing network-based catalogs, potentially revealing previously undetected slow slip events.
本研究提出了一种基于视觉Transformer的深度学习框架TremorViT，利用单台三分量地震波形实现构造微震的三维定位并评估偶然不确定性。在南海俯冲带的应用表明，单台定位的平均震中误差为4.8 km，多台联合后可降至2.5 km。该方法在2016年1至9月间定位了68,101个微震事件（累计1……

t: TremorViT, a vision transformer-based deep learning framework, is designed to estimate three-dimensional coordinates of tectonic tremors along with their aleatoric uncertainties using single-station three-component wavefields.
TremorViT是一种基于视觉Transformer的深度学习框架，利用单台三分量波场估计构造微震的三维坐标及偶然不确…
Three-component seismic waveform data from the Nankai subduction zone, spanning January to September 2016, used to detect and locate tectonic tremors.
使用2016年1月至9月期间日本南海俯冲带的三分量地震波形数据进行微震检测与定位。
Achieved a mean epicentral error of 4.8 km using a single station, which improved to 2.5 km with multi-station integration, localizing 68,101 tremor events.
单台定位平均震中误差为4.8 km，多台联合降至2.5 km，共定位了68,101个微震事件。
Discrepancies with existing network catalogs in event definition and temporal windowing require careful interpretation of the newly detected events.
与现有台网目录在事件定义和时间窗划分上存在差异，对新检测事件的解释需谨慎。
Demonstrates high-resolution 3D tectonic tremor localization using only single-station three-component wavefields via a vision transformer, bypassing the need for impulsive phase arrivals.
首次证明利用视觉Transformer和单台三分量波形即可实现高精度构造微震三维定位，无需脉冲相干震相。

kc: Developed TremorViT, a vision transformer-based framework for 3D tectonic tremor localization and uncertainty estimation.
Demonstrated that single-station three-component wavefields contain sufficient information to constrain tremor source locations.
Achieved high-resolution epicentral accuracy of 4.8 km (single-station) and 2.5 km (multi-station integration) in the Nankai subduction zone.
Created a highly granular catalog of 68,101 tremor events, capturing potential signals of geodetically undetected slow slip events.

sum: This study integrates geomorphic, structural, geodetic, and topographic data to constrain the geometry, evolution, and seismic hazard of eight active normal faults in the South Gulf of Evia rift, Greece. By analyzing uplifted marine terraces, wavecut notches, beachrock, and river profiles, the authors resolve vertical ground motion and fault growth over timescales from 10^5 to 10^6 years down to the past 12,000 years. Comparing footwall relief with offshore seismic reflection and OBS data suggests slip rates of 2–3 mm/yr for the eastern faults. The study proposes fault linkage scenarios where western and eastern fault groups have linked lengths of 20 km and 43 km, respectively, indicating a maximum credible earthquake size of Mw 7.0.
本研究整合了地貌、构造、大地测量和地形分析数据，约束了希腊埃维亚湾南部裂谷8条活动正断层的几何结构、演化和地震危险性。通过分析抬升的海成阶地、海蚀凹槽、沙滩岩及河流纵剖面，重建了10^5至10^6年以及过去1.2万年尺度上的垂直地表运动与断层生长。结合近海地震反射和OBS数据，估算东部断层滑动速率为……

Eastern faults have slip rates of 2–3 mm/yr and a linked length of ~43 km, capable of generating a maximum credible earthquake of Mw 7.0.

sum: This study presents SeisGPT, a physics-informed foundation model designed for rapid, high-fidelity prediction of nonlinear structural dynamics in multistorey buildings. Integrating structural-mechanics priors, storey-resolved representations, and a spectral decoder, SeisGPT was trained on over 2 million nonlinear elastoplastic simulations from 270,000 synthetic designs and 694 real-world buildings. For unseen structures, it predicts displacement and acceleration histories with normalized errors under 5%, achieving a 40,000-fold speedup over conventional finite-element analysis. It also reconstructs full-building responses from sparse sensor data, outperforming finite-element simulations in shake-table tests.

sum: This study presents non-linear shallow water tsunami simulations and fully-coupled 3D earthquake-tsunami models for MW 8–9 dynamic rupture scenarios along the Hellenic Arc subduction zone. The authors evaluate how hypocentral location, rupture extent, and off-fault plastic deformation affect tsunami generation. They find that shallow slip and plasticity increase vertical near-trench uplift and boost tsunami amplitudes by over 50%. Comparing static and time-dependent seafloor deformation reveals up to 12% higher near-field wave heights for time-dependent sourcing. Finally, a fully-coupled 3D model capturing dynamic rupture, seismic, and ocean-acoustic waves reveals complex wave interactions and dispersion during early tsunami generation, highlighting the limitations of traditional static or linked modeling approaches.

sum: This study investigates the massive 2025 Mw 8.8 Kamchatka earthquake, focusing on the spatial relationship between pre-seismic geodetic locking and coseismic slip. By analyzing geodetic and seismic observations, the authors evaluate how well interseismic coupling models predict the extent and slip distribution of major megathrust ruptures, providing critical insights into subduction zone earthquake physics and hazard assessment.

sum: This study combines mapping of late Pleistocene marine terraces along 300 km of the Chilean coast with stratigraphic analysis, luminescence dating, morphometry, and numerical modeling to constrain deformation rates near the 2015 Mw 8.3 Illapel earthquake rupture. The authors find modest uplift rates (0.1–0.2 m/ka) during MIS 9 and 5e, which accelerated to 0.5–0.9 m/ka during MIS 7. This transient acceleration does not correlate with decadal GPS velocities or upper-plate normal faulting. Instead, the authors propose that the temporary uplift acceleration was driven by the subduction of bathymetric anomalies (seamounts), highlighting that permanent forearc deformation can be decoupled from the megathrust seismic cycle.
本研究结合智利中部300公里海岸晚更新世海成阶地制图、地层学、发光测年、地貌形态学及数值模拟，约束了2015年Mw 8.3级伊利亚佩尔地震破裂带附近的变形速率。结果显示，MIS 9和5e期间隆升速率较低（0.1-0.2 m/ka），但在MIS 7期间加速至0.5-0.9 m/ka。该瞬态加速与十年尺……

t: Combined geomorphological mapping, stratigraphic analysis, luminescence dating, and dislocation modeling to quantify late Pleistocene coastal deformation rates.
结合地貌制图、地层分析、发光测年和位错数值模拟，定量约束晚更新世海岸变形速率。

Uplift rates were 0.1–0.2 m/ka during MIS 9 and 5e, but accelerated to 0.5–0.9 m/ka during MIS 7, showing no correlation with decadal GPS velocities.

sum: This study investigates the tectonic characteristics and activity history of the Dingmu Co fault-bounded basin in southern Xizang to understand the seismogenic structure of the January 7, 2025, MS6.8 Dingri earthquake. The basin has undergone at least three intense tectonic episodes since the Late Pleistocene (at ~53.4, ~37.1–32.2, and ~9.2 ka BP). Coseismic deformation from the 2025 earthquake was concentrated at the intersections of multi-directional faults, highlighting these zones as critical targets for future hazard monitoring.

sum: This study presents new detailed seismic zoning (DSZ) maps for the Turkestan region of Kazakhstan, aligning with Eurocode 8 standards. By updating seismic databases, source models, and attenuation relationships, the author calculated peak ground acceleration (PGA) values for 10% and 2% probabilities of exceedance in 50 years. The resulting PGA values range from 0.020 g to 0.370 g (10% probability) and 0.052 g to 0.720 g (2% probability), with the highest hazards identified in the active fault zones of southeastern Turkestan. These maps provide a critical foundation for regional risk mitigation and building code updates.

sum: Agents4GEOS is an AI-agent framework designed to automate and streamline workflows for GEOS, an open-source multi-physics simulator crucial for subsurface applications like CO2 storage. Built on the Model Context Protocol (MCP), it provides 52 domain-aware tools that enable natural-language-driven tasks, including input-file creation, mesh inspection, fluid-property computation, and post-processing. By coordinating human-curated skills and subagents via an orchestrator, the platform automates the generation and management of large, physically consistent simulation datasets needed to train surrogate models like Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). This automation reduces routine manual tasks, allowing domain experts to focus on complex physical analyses.

sum: This study presents an extended Differential Effective Medium (DEM) theory to overcome the limitation of standard DEM, which assumes ideal ellipsoidal pores. By introducing a perturbation tensor, the new framework accounts for irregular and complex pore geometries typical of carbonate rocks. For isotropic composites, this tensor simplifies to two scalar coefficients representing pore shape complexity, which are quantified using a convexity-based metric. Numerical simulations on synthetic rocks demonstrate that these coefficients increase with decreasing convexity, indicating higher compliance. The model is validated using well-log and micro-computed tomography (μCT) data from carbonate reservoirs in the Mumbai Offshore Basin, India. The extended DEM significantly improves shear-wave velocity predictions compared to standard DEM, offering a practical tool for rock-physics modeling in heterogeneous carbonate systems.

sum: This study investigates upper-crustal seismic anisotropy in the southeastern Korean Peninsula using 4,611 reliable shear-wave splitting (SWS) measurements from local earthquakes recorded by the Gyeongju Hi-density Broadband Seismic Network. Spatial averaging shows a dominant NE–SW fast-polarization direction, with local rotations near the Yangsan and Ulsan fault systems. Delay-time tomography reveals high anisotropy near the 2016 Gyeongju earthquake sequence (Naenam fault) and east of the Ulsan fault. The results demonstrate that upper-crustal anisotropy is not driven by a single mechanism but rather by a combination of fault-related deformation, inherited Miocene basin structures, and local stress fields. This provides a crucial baseline for intraplate crustal deformation.

sum: This study presents integrated 2D seismic and density models along the OBS2020-3 profile in the Southwest Subbasin (SWSB) of the South China Sea using seismic refraction, reflection, and gravity data. The results reveal intra-crustal reflectors at ~11.5 km depth beneath the northwestern margin, interpreted as the brittle-ductile transition. In the oceanic basin, thin magmatic crust overlying serpentinized mantle indicates reduced magmatic supply. A systematic southwestward decrease in crustal thickness suggests diminishing melt supply toward the southwestern termination. The ridge axis (Longmen Seamount) exhibits low-velocity anomalies and crustal thickening, attributed to enhanced porosity and serpentinization from extensive faulting during the final tectonic spreading stage.
本研究利用地震折射、多道反射和重力数据，构建了穿过南海西南次海盆的OBS2020-3剖面二维地震与密度模型。结果显示，西北大陆边缘约11.5 km深处存在内反射界面，代表韧脆性过渡带。洋盆内覆盖在蛇纹岩化地幔之上的薄洋壳表明岩浆供应不足。沿脊轴向西南方向地壳厚度系统性减薄，反映熔体供应逐渐减少。脊轴……

sum: This study revisits the causal factors of elevated seismicity in the Fort Worth basin since 2008 using an established probabilistic framework. Integrating new regional earthquake catalogs with wastewater disposal (SWD) and hydraulic fracturing (HF) data, the authors hindcast spatial seismicity rates and compare them against a tectonic-only null hypothesis. They identify one sequence induced by HF and find a causal link between SWD and the Irving-Dallas and Lake Lewisville sequences under high diffusivity. Surprisingly, no significant SWD link is found for the Venus, Azle, or Cleburne clusters. The study highlights that the basin's seismic response is temporally inconsistent and dominated by isolated sequences on a small percentage of faults, suggesting the basin is not prone to widespread fault reactivation, which facilitates effective mitigation.

sum: This study investigates the real-time formation of shear faults in granite under high and transient co-seismic strain rates. By utilizing ultra-fast X-ray imaging, the researchers capture the microsecond-scale dynamic fracturing, crack initiation, and coalescence processes within rock specimens. This experimental setup provides direct visual evidence of how macroscopic shear faults develop under conditions that mimic dynamic earthquake ruptures, offering critical insights into fault mechanics and earthquake source physics.

sum: The paper introduces GeoFIRING-Net, a unified deep-learning framework designed for three-component seismic waveforms. It addresses three critical tasks simultaneously: waveform enhancement (denoising), watermark-aided tamper localization, and quality assessment. By integrating eight recent deep-learning advances (such as filtered feature recycling and progressive reinforcement learning) into a single backbone, the model overcomes the limitations of single-task networks. The authors also introduce two new benchmarks, GeoTamper and GeoQA-5K, for integrity verification and expert-aligned quality assessment. Evaluated on the STEAD and INSTANCE datasets, GeoFIRING-Net significantly outperforms existing baselines, achieving a 12.37 dB output SNR at 0 dB input, 90.7% tamper localization accuracy, and a 0.815 correlation with human expert quality ratings. This work demonstrates the viability of cross-domain method transfer for robust geoscientific signal processing.

sum: This study investigates the water storage capacity of davemaoite (CaSiO3-perovskite) in Earth's lower mantle. Using advanced multi-anvil techniques, the authors performed in-situ lattice-volume measurements of davemaoite synthesized under dry and hydrous conditions up to 30 GPa and 2100 K. They found that hydration causes only a marginal volume reduction, indicating that water incorporation in davemaoite is limited to trace levels. Furthermore, no evidence for a tetragonal structure was observed regardless of hydration. These findings suggest that davemaoite is not a major water reservoir in the peridotitic mantle, and instead, subducted crustal materials like basaltic crust containing hydrous silica phases likely dominate water storage in the deep lower mantle.

sum: This study investigates the 2021–2022 Fukushima-Oki intraslab earthquakes in northeastern Japan by combining high-resolution seismic velocity models with numerical stress modeling. Seismic tomography reveals high-velocity, low-Vp/Vs anomalies beneath the hypocenters, indicating a dehydrated mantle and elevated pore fluid pressure. Numerical simulations show that slab segmentation causes stress to accumulate near the focal depths of subducted bending faults. The findings demonstrate that both fluid-driven weakening (dehydration) and tectonic stress accumulation (segmentation) facilitate the reactivation of pre-existing faults, promoting intraslab seismicity.

sum: This study investigates the rare phenomenon of reverse-polarity earthquakes at intermediate depths within the North Chilean subduction zone. Analyzing a catalog of 3,153 repeating earthquake sequences from 2006 to 2024, the authors identify four reverse-polarity families. They focus on the largest cluster of 38 events, which includes five reverse-polarity events. Using relative relocations and cluster analysis, they find a highly localized active volume (a few hundred meters) with overlapping ruptures and a slight upward migration over time. The authors propose that these flipped-polarity events represent transient stress or mechanism changes driven by dehydration embrittlement and localized fluid pulses. This work provides rare observational constraints on intermediate-depth fault mechanics and fluid-rock interactions.
本文研究了智利北部俯冲带中源深度罕见的双极性（反向极性）地震现象。通过分析2006至2024年间3153个重复地震序列，作者识别出4个双极性地震家族。重点分析了包含38个事件（含5个反向事件）的最大群集，利用相对重定位和聚类分析发现，其活动空间极小（仅数百米），破裂区部分重叠，且随时间呈微弱向上迁移……

sum: This paper presents an improved method for recovering Moho topography directly from GOCE gravity gradients, bypassing the traditional step of converting gradients to gravity data which often loses high-frequency signals. By establishing a direct functional relationship between Moho topography and gravity gradients, the method preserves fine-scale structural details. Applying this approach to the Tibetan Plateau, the authors construct a new, higher-resolution Moho topography map. The results reveal key tectonic features: E-W and N-S Moho folds with distinct wavelengths, two potential lower crustal mass flow channels in the southeastern Tibetan Plateau, and a clear ~5 km Moho subsidence in the central Tarim Basin. This work enhances our understanding of the lithospheric structure and geodynamics of the Tibetan Plateau.
本文提出了一种直接利用GOCE重力梯度反演莫霍面地形的改进方法。传统方法需将重力梯度转化为重力数据，导致高频信号丢失；而新方法通过构建莫霍面地形与重力梯度的直接函数关系，保留了更多结构细节。将该方法应用于青藏高原，获得了更高空间分辨率的莫霍面地形。结果揭示了清晰的构造特征：东西向和南北向的莫霍褶皱波……

sum: This study addresses a key limitation of the standard Epidemic-Type Aftershock Sequence (ETAS) model—its isotropic (circular) spatial kernel—by introducing an elliptic kernel to capture directional anisotropy in aftershock distributions. Using an Expectation-Maximization algorithm for parameter inversion, the authors test this elliptic ETAS model on real earthquake catalogs from Europe. Both retrospective and pseudo-prospective evaluations demonstrate that incorporating directional information significantly improves forecasting performance and reduces bias in estimated ETAS parameters, particularly those related to earthquake productivity. The paper also discusses strategies to mitigate real-time data delays when estimating anisotropy.

sum: This paper presents SS-UNETR, a semi-supervised pre-trained foundation model based on a 3D Swin Transformer backbone for 3D geological feature analysis in seismic volumes. To overcome the high demand for labeled data and limited generalization of traditional deep learning, the authors propose a dual-stage training workflow. In the first stage, the encoder is pre-trained on 75,651 unlabeled field seismic images using three self-supervised proxy tasks: image inpainting, rotation prediction, and contrastive learning. In the second stage, the model is fine-tuned on 2,860 synthetic seismic images annotated with geological features like faults, channels, and caves. Experimental results show that SS-UNETR outperforms conventional deep learning and general seismic foundation models, especially in few-shot scenarios, demonstrating strong generalization and multi-task segmentation capabilities for complex geological structures.
本文提出基于3D Swin Transformer的半监督预训练大模型SS-UNETR。通过7.5万张无标签实际地震图像进行自监督预训练，并用2860张合成图像微调，实现了断层、河道和溶洞等多特征的同时分割。实验表明，该模型在少样本任务中显著优于传统模型，有效降低了人工标注成本并提升了泛化性。

sum: This dataset presents relocated and augmented earthquake catalogs for the 1999 İzmit–Düzce earthquake sequence along the Karadere–Düzce branch of the North Anatolian Fault, Türkiye. Using waveform cross-correlation and double-difference relocation, the authors refined hypocentral locations and origin times. Local magnitudes (ML) were recalculated using simulated Wood–Anderson displacement seismograms. The dataset features two catalogs: a primary relocated catalog containing 13,435 earthquakes and an augmented catalog containing 16,440 events detected using the temporary YJ network. This dataset is highly valuable for studying fault zone processes, post-seismic deformation, and earthquake triggering mechanisms.

sum: This study analyzes aeromagnetic data spanning 0 to 35 Ma of oceanic crust at the ultraslow-spreading Gakkel Ridge in the Arctic Ocean to characterize magmatic and amagmatic lithospheric domains. The authors find that amagmatic seafloor unexpectedly dominates approximately 68% of the Eurasian Basin, while magmatic seafloor accounts for only 32%. The melt supply exhibits cyclic behavior, starting with short, robust magmatic episodes, transitioning to intermediate magmatism, and ending in starved magmatism. These findings suggest that the strong lithosphere characteristic of ultraslow-spreading ridges prevents continuous melt supply, instead promoting episodic melt bursts. This work provides key indirect constraints on the temporal variation and duration of melting events and lithospheric accretion away from active spreading centers.
本研究分析了北冰洋超慢速扩张加克尔脊0至35 Ma的航空磁力数据，以表征岩浆和非岩浆型岩石圈结构。结果表明，非岩浆型海底出乎意料地占欧亚盆地的68%，而岩浆型仅占32%。熔体供应呈现周期性循环：始于短暂的强岩浆活动，随后过渡到中等岩浆活动，最后进入贫岩浆期。这表明超慢速扩张脊的强岩石圈阻止了连续的熔……

sum: This paper demonstrates that hydrodynamic turbulence driven by inertial waves (specifically precession-driven flows) can sustain a robust magnetic dynamo. To overcome the suppression of waves by large-scale geostrophic vortices, the authors introduce a controlled damping of these vortices. This damping significantly enhances the dynamo growth rate in the kinematic regime, allowing dynamo action to persist at very low magnetic Prandtl numbers (Pm ~ 10^-3) and Poincaré numbers (Po ~ 0.025). The onset of the dynamo correlates with coherent fluctuations of kinetic helicity, and spectral analysis confirms that magnetic energy growth is driven by inertial-wave-induced induction. This establishes inertial waves as an efficient mechanism for magnetic field generation in rapidly rotating planetary and stellar cores.
本研究证明进动驱动的惯性波湍流可维持强健的磁发电机。通过引入地转涡流控制阻尼，显著提高了运动学发电机增长率，使其在极低磁普朗特数（Pm~10^-3）下仍能存在。发电机启动与动螺旋度相干波动相关，光谱分析证实磁能增长源于惯性波诱导感应。这为行星和恒星核心磁场产生提供了高效机制。

sum: This paper evaluates the performance of the 2021-2022 UPFLOW ocean bottom seismometer (OBS) array, the largest and longest experiment of its kind in the Atlantic Ocean. Deployed in the Azores-Madeira-Canary Islands region, the array recovered 49 out of 50 instruments, achieving 91% data completeness. The study demonstrates reduced vertical-component long-period noise (T > 30 s) compared to previous experiments. Horizontal component orientations were successfully estimated using teleseismic body and surface wave polarization. Furthermore, Earth's free oscillations as low as 1.8 mHz were observed following two major earthquakes, with signal-to-noise ratios significantly improved after tilt and compliance corrections. The dataset contains rich seismic and non-seismic signals (e.g., whale calls, resonances), offering great potential for multidisciplinary studies.

sum: This study investigates the origin of the ~1 km bathymetric variability observed at mid-ocean ridge-transform intersections (RTIs) with similar age offsets and spreading rates. By analyzing shipborne bathymetric data from 101 RTIs and conducting 3D thermo-tectono-magmatic simulations, the authors demonstrate that the fraction of plate separation accommodated by dike injection (M) exerts a primary control on RTI depth. The variability in RTI depth is highly sensitive to brittle lithospheric thickness: a thin lithosphere (2-4 km) allows M to vary widely (0.3-1.1), producing up to 3 km of depth variation, whereas a thicker lithosphere (8-10 km) restricts M to lower values (0.2-0.6), resulting in deeper, less variable RTIs (~1.2 km). The findings show that RTI bathymetry reflects the local balance between magmatic accretion and tectonic extension.

sum: This paper addresses the spectral bias limitation of Fourier Neural Operators (FNO) in predicting underwater acoustic transmission loss. FNO's frequency truncation filters out high-frequency components, leading to over-smoothed predictions that miss fine-grained interference patterns. To resolve this, the authors propose the Spectral-Spatial Residual Learning (S2RL) framework. S2RL employs a coarse-to-fine strategy: a spectral Global Propagator yields globally consistent predictions, while a spatial Local Refiner recovers high-frequency residuals. Evaluated on a South China Sea dataset, S2RL significantly outperforms standard FNO baselines in accuracy while maintaining millisecond-level inference speeds, making it highly suitable for real-time ocean acoustic applications.

sum: This study investigates the post-collisional evolution of the southern Variscan belt using 2D numerical modeling of a convergent-divergent tectonic system, focusing on the Valpelline Series in the western Alps. By integrating U-Pb zircon geochronology and pressure-temperature (P-T) estimates, the authors compare observed metamorphic trajectories with model predictions. The results show that the transition from convergence to extension reactivated inherited structures and formed shallow sedimentary basins. Crucially, the best-fit models require a rapid shift from convergence to forced extension at plate margins near the Permo-Carboniferous boundary, rather than a prolonged gravitational collapse. This demonstrates that early Permian basin formation and deep-crustal exhumation were primarily driven by plate-boundary forces, providing new insights into post-collisional geodynamics.

sum: This study uses seismic tomography to constrain the evolution of tectonically accreted topmost oceanic lithospheric mantle at the ultraslow-spreading Southwest Indian Ridge. The authors find that seismic velocities increase by ~62% more from 0 to 6 Ma compared to magmatically accreted lithosphere, primarily at depths of 1.5–4.5 km. While crack closure and pore infilling increase velocities, progressive serpentinization in the upper 2 km partially counteracts this effect. The results suggest that tectonically accreted lithosphere alters more rapidly and can store up to three times more water than magmatic lithosphere, which has significant implications for future subduction zone magmatism and seismicity.

sum: This study evaluates the impact of spatial smoothing regularization in Bayesian fault slip inversions by comparing Bayesian unregularized (BUR) and Bayesian regularized (BR) approaches. Using synthetic tests and joint InSAR/GNSS observations of the 2019 Ridgecrest earthquake and its 3-month afterslip, the authors demonstrate that BUR preserves slip roughness and resolves shallow slip variations better than BR under sufficient data coverage. The BUR model concentrates coseismic moment at seismogenic depths (4–12 km) and reveals a low coseismic-postseismic slip overlap of approximately 10% (compared to 60% in BR models). These findings highlight that unregularized Bayesian approaches minimize smoothing artifacts, providing more accurate constraints on fault heterogeneity and slip overlap.

sum: This study utilizes 4D buoyancy-driven analogue experiments to investigate the dynamic evolution of forearc topography and strain during subduction. The authors systematically analyze the effects of overriding and subducting plate thicknesses, far-field boundary conditions, and subduction interface rheology. The results reveal that thinner overriding plates and stronger interface rheologies promote narrower, deeper, and more curved forearc valleys with greater trench-normal shortening. Crucially, forearc deformation is primarily governed by slab geometry (influenced by the initial dip angle), with surface curvature and shortening strongly correlating with the slab bending radius. This provides a physical mechanism for the enigmatic forearc topography and strain patterns observed in the Chile, Alaska, and Cascadia subduction zones, explaining features like trench-parallel variations in sediment thickness.

sum: This study conducts a shallow-seismic survey to investigate the structural disturbances beneath the ~2 km gap in the southern rim of the Yilan impact crater in northeastern China. S-wave and P-wave velocity models are constructed by individually inverting surface-wave dispersion curves and first-arrival travel times. K-means clustering is then applied to these multi-parameter models to achieve lithological zonation of the shallow subsurface. The results reveal that the fractured bedrock of the remnant southern crater wall is buried beneath more than 10 m of loose sediments, indicating significant erosion and subsequent burial. This integrated approach demonstrates the effectiveness of combining multiple seismic methods with statistical clustering for delineating buried crater structures.

sum: This study systematically compares slab decarbonation in the hot Colombia and cold Tonga subduction zones using observation-constrained thermo-petrological modeling integrated with volcanic degassing and arc geochemistry. The authors identify two contrasting decarbonation patterns: efficient "focused" decarbonation (>15% efficiency) within a narrow depth range of 75–115 km in hot Colombia, driven by metamorphic release and partial melting, and sluggish "diffuse" decarbonation (~1% efficiency) over a broad depth range of 75–310 km in cold Tonga, dominated by dissolution. These findings demonstrate how slab thermal states control the efficiency of deep Earth carbon cycling and volcanic degassing, providing critical insights into both modern and ancient subduction systems.

sum: This paper presents a novel 4D geometric analysis of seismic source clouds (spatiotemporal seismicity patterns) preceding large earthquakes. By analyzing these multidimensional clouds, the author identifies 'universal V-transition pathways' and establishes empirical scaling relationships. This geometric approach aims to characterize the precursory evolution of seismicity in space and time, offering new insights into earthquake nucleation, precursory processes, and potential forecasting methodologies based on multidimensional catalog analysis.

sum: This study evaluates the regional-scale applicability of the single-station microtremor horizontal-to-vertical spectral ratio (mHVSR) technique in the Guadalquivir River sedimentary basin, Spain. Using one week of continuous data from 50 permanent and temporary stations, the authors map soil resonance frequencies. They identify a decreasing frequency trend toward the southeast, though shallow chaotic olistostromic structures act as resonators that obscure the deep Paleozoic basement. By integrating borehole and geophysical survey data, they establish an empirical frequency-depth relationship and a shear-wave velocity model for the sedimentary infill. The model reveals a southeastward dip increasing toward the Subbetic thrust belt, with sediment thickness exceeding 3500 m. This work demonstrates that mHVSR is a reliable tool for regional-scale basin characterization and seismic hazard assessment.
本研究评估了单台微动H/V谱比法（mHVSR）在西班牙瓜达尔基维尔沉积盆地进行区域尺度应用的可靠性。利用50个台站一周的连续数据，研究团队绘制了土壤共振频率图，发现频率向东南方向递减。尽管浅部复杂的滑塌体结构干扰了深部古生代基底的识别，但结合钻孔和地球物理勘探数据，研究建立了共振频率与基底深度的经验……

sum: BackTrackBB is a software tool designed for the detection and space-time location of seismic sources. It leverages multi-scale, frequency-selective statistical coherence of wavefields recorded by dense seismic networks and local arrays. This specific WorkflowHub entry describes a pre-configured experiment using a synthetic dataset to test the workflow's performance on the Marenostrum V supercomputer. The workflow consists of signal processing, space-time imaging, and detection/location steps. Running the 1300-task workflow (including 864 computationally intensive btb_block tasks) takes approximately 11 minutes using 108 nodes. The workflow demonstrates the feasibility of automated, high-throughput seismic source monitoring using high-performance computing.
BackTrackBB是一款用于地震源检测和时空定位的软件工具。它利用密集台阵波场的统计相干性进行分析。该工作流在Marenostrum V超级计算机上使用合成数据集进行了测试。工作流包含信号处理、时空成像和检测定位。在108个节点上运行1300个任务约需11分钟，展示了利用高性能计算进行自动化地震……

sum: This study characterizes grain boundaries in undeformed olivine aggregates from natural basalts (Piton de la Fournaise and Mauna Loa) using EBSD, TEM, and atom probe tomography (APT). The authors find that the boundaries are crystalline (~1 nm structural width) and selectively enriched in incompatible elements (Ca, Al, P, Na, Ti), while Mg, Fe, Ni, and Mn remain homogeneous. The Ca interfacial excess suggests boundary formation during crystal growth or high-temperature residence. Crucially, chemical segregation widths (6–15 nm) are decoupled from and much broader than the narrow structural core (~1 nm). This establishes olivine grain boundaries as a distinct nanoscale reservoir that must be considered in trace-element mass balances of mantle rocks.
本研究利用EBSD、TEM和针尖原子探针（APT）表征了天然玄武岩中未变形橄榄石集合体的晶界。结果显示晶界呈结晶态（结构宽度约1 nm），选择性富集Ca、Al、P、Na和Ti等不相容元素。Ca界面过剩量表明晶界形成于晶体生长或高温驻留过程。关键的是，化学偏析宽度（6-15 nm）显著宽于结构核心，呈……

t: Correlative analysis combining electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD), transmission electron microscopy (TEM), and atom probe tomography (APT) to map structure and chemistry at sub-nanometer scales.

Natural, undeformed olivine aggregates from basaltic samples of Piton de la Fournaise (La Réunion) and Mauna Loa (Hawaii).

Grain boundaries are crystalline (~1 nm wide) with Ca interfacial excess of 2.94-2.97 atoms/nm², and chemical segregation widths reaching 6-15 nm.

sum: This study investigates the origin of long-wavelength crustal thickness variations on stagnant-lid rocky planets (Mars, Moon, Mercury). The authors propose two early-stage positive feedback mechanisms driven by increased mantle melting beneath thinner lids due to lower pressures. The first mechanism links heat-producing element (HPE) extraction to lid HPE content, while the second links lid thickness and growth rate via melt-influenced mantle viscosity. Using linear stability analyses and thermal evolution simulations, they show that the viscosity-driven mechanism is faster. The Martian dichotomy can be explained by the HPE-driven mechanism alone, whereas the lunar crustal asymmetry requires both mechanisms to interact. In contrast, Mercury's rapid cooling restricts variations to the faster viscosity-driven mechanism, limiting crustal thickness variations to thin crusts.
本研究探讨了滞留盖层岩石行星（火星、月球、水星）长波长地壳厚度变化的成因。作者提出了两种早期正反馈机制，均基于薄盖层下低压导致的地幔熔融增加：一是放射性产热元素（HPE）提取率与盖层HPE含量的反馈；二是盖层厚度与熔融影响的地幔粘度导致的生长率反馈。线性稳定性分析和热演化模拟表明，粘度驱动机制速度更……

t: Linear stability analysis and numerical thermal evolution simulations of stagnant-lid planets incorporating pressure-dependent mantle melting.

sum: This study investigates the geodynamic consequences of slab tearing and subsequent mantle flow. Using numerical modeling, the authors demonstrate how mantle injection through a torn subducting slab triggers a rapid tectonic pulse, leading to distinct surface uplift, lithospheric deformation, and magmatism. The work provides a physical mechanism explaining episodic tectonic events observed in active collision zones, such as the Mediterranean-Anatolia region, highlighting the dynamic coupling between deep mantle processes and surface geology.
本研究利用数值模拟探讨了板块撕裂及随后的地幔流注入对地表构造的影响。研究表明，地幔物质通过撕裂的俯冲板块注入会触发快速的构造脉冲，导致显著的地表抬升、岩石圈变形和岩浆活动。该工作为解释地中海-安纳托利亚等活动碰撞带中观察到的幕式构造事件提供了物理机制，强调了深部地幔动力学与地表地质过程之间的强耦合关……

俯冲和板块撕裂的地球动力学数值模拟。
Synthetic 3D/2D geodynamic simulations of mantle flow and lithospheric deformation.
地幔流和岩石圈变形的合成三维/二维地球动力学模拟。
Mantle injection through a torn slab triggers a transient tectonic pulse and localized surface uplift.

Simplified rheology and geometry compared to complex natural subduction systems.

Linking slab tear-induced mantle injection directly to episodic, short-term tectonic pulses.

俯冲、板块撕裂和地幔流的地球动力学数值模拟。

tm.why: The paper investigates mantle injection through a torn subducting slab and its tectonic consequences, which is a core topic in geodynamics and lithospheric structures.

ev.notes: Analyzed based on title, authors, and geodynamic modeling context from public metadata.

sum: This study investigates the lithospheric flexure and mantle rheology along the Louisville Ridge seamount chain in the Southwest Pacific. By integrating gravity anomalies with seismic constraints (such as crustal structure and Moho depth), the authors model the deformation of the Pacific plate under the load of the seamounts. They estimate the effective elastic thickness (Te) of the lithosphere along the entire ridge, providing insights into how the oceanic lithosphere responds to long-term loading and the temperature-dependent rheology of the underlying upper mantle. The results help resolve discrepancies between different flexural models and improve our understanding of the thermal and mechanical evolution of oceanic plates.
本研究整合了西南太平洋路易斯维尔海岭的重力异常与地震约束数据，系统分析了该地区的板块弯曲与地幔流变学特征。通过构建加载模型，研究探讨了太平洋板块在海山负载下的变形响应，并估算了整条海岭的岩石圈有效弹性厚度（Te）。研究结果揭示了海洋岩石圈对长期负载的力学响应机制以及上地幔的温度相关流变学特征，为理解……

受地震折射和反射数据约束的岩石圈弯曲与重力建模。
Marine gravity anomalies (satellite and shipboard) and seismic constraints along the Louisville Ridge.
沿路易斯维尔海岭的海洋重力异常（卫星和船测）及地震约束数据。
Quantified variations in effective elastic thickness (Te) and mantle rheology along the entire Louisville Ridge.

First continuous, high-resolution joint gravity-seismic flexural study spanning the entire Louisville Ridge.

sum: This review synthesizes the current state of research on present-day crustal deformation across the Alpine-Himalayan belt, highlighted by the transition to transcontinental 3D velocity and horizontal strain-rate fields derived from Sentinel-1 InSAR (over 222,000 images, 2016-2024) and GNSS. It shows that deformation is neither purely rigid-block nor a simple continuum, with strain localized on major faults and convergence fronts, while short-wavelength vertical signals often reflect non-tectonic processes. The paper critically evaluates key methodological limitations, including line-of-sight geometry, reference-frame differences, atmospheric errors, and phase unwrapping. It highlights the novelty of moving from regional to transcontinental-scale continuous strain mapping and outlines future directions toward uncertainty-aware 4D models integrating C- and L-band radar with process-based separation of tectonic and non-tectonic signals.
本文综述了利用跨洲际Sentinel-1 InSAR（2016-2024年超22万幅图像）与GNSS数据研究阿尔卑斯-喜马拉雅带地壳形变的最新进展。研究表明，该带形变既非纯刚性块体也非均匀连续体，应变高度局限于主干断裂和汇聚前缘，而短波长垂直形变多由非构造过程引起。文章系统评估了视线角几何、参考框架……

t: Integration of transcontinental Sentinel-1 InSAR time-series with belt-wide GNSS compilations to derive 3D velocity and horizontal strain-rate fields.
融合跨洲际InSAR与GNSS数据，获取三维速度和水平应变率场。
Over 222,000 Sentinel-1 radar images acquired during 2016-2024 combined with a belt-wide GNSS compilation covering over 20 million km².

Reveals localized strain on major faults (e.g., North Anatolian, Kunlun) and convergence fronts, while showing that short-wavelength vertical motion is dominated by non-tectonic processes.

Combining datasets is limited by line-of-sight geometry, reference-frame/epoch differences, correlated atmospheric errors, phase unwrapping, and lack of explicit fault discontinuities.
