sum: This study addresses the ongoing unrest at Campi Flegrei caldera by comparing 3D thermo-mechanical models of deep magma migration with thermo-poro-viscoelastic models of shallow gas-rich reservoir pressurization. By integrating seismic imaging, geodesy, and rock physics constraints, the authors test these competing hypotheses against InSAR and GNSS observations. The results show that while magma migration explains the first-order spatial deformation pattern, it cannot match the full amplitude and temporal evolution under independent constraints. Instead, shallow gas accumulation and hydrothermal pressurization successfully reproduce the 25-year spatiotemporal deformation history, though spatial discrepancies emerge after the onset of seismic unrest. This work highlights the necessity of multi-physics modeling and interdisciplinary constraints to resolve the drivers of volcanic unrest.
本研究针对坎皮佛莱格瑞火山的持续隆起，对比了深部岩浆运移的3D热力学模型与浅部富气储层超压的多孔粘弹性模型。结合地震成像、大地测量和岩石物理约束，并与InSAR和GNSS观测对比。结果表明，岩浆运移仅能解释一阶形变格局，而浅部气体积累和热液加压能更好地重构25年的时空形变历史。这展示了多物理场模拟在……

t: 3D thermo-mechanical and thermo-poro-viscoelastic finite-element modeling integrating seismic, geodetic, and rock physics constraints.
结合地震、大地测量和岩石物理约束的3D热力学与多孔粘弹性有限元模拟。
InSAR and GNSS geodetic observations of ground deformation at Campi Flegrei caldera spanning the past 25 years.

sum: The authors present exist-fdsn-station, an open-source implementation of the FDSN station web service (fdsnws-station) API. Built on a native XML database management system, it extends the standard read-only API to support controlled write and interaction operations with StationXML metadata. This schema-less database approach allows seamless ingestion of heterogeneous metadata while preserving the original XML structure. The software is containerized for easy integration into larger distributed infrastructures. Performance tests demonstrate predictable scaling with data size, proving its capability to handle large aggregated metadata collections. It is currently operational at the INGV data center.

sum: This study introduces a novel physical method to track changes in stored elastic energy within the crust during volcanic unrest. By balancing the energy supplied by an underground pressurizing fluid source against the energy released through local seismicity, the method identifies the transition to net energy decrease, which marks the onset of bulk fracture growth. The authors successfully test and validate this energy-balance model using historical unrest sequences from two major calderas: Sierra Negra (Galápagos) and Campi Flegrei (Italy). This approach provides a practical, physics-based forecasting tool to recognize when a reawakening volcano is approaching crustal rupture and potential eruption, moving beyond purely empirical seismic rate analyses.
本文提出一种追踪火山复苏期地壳弹性储能变化的新方法。该方法通过平衡地下压力源输入能量与地震释放能量，识别储能净减少的临界点，即裂缝加速扩展的起点。研究利用塞拉内格拉和坎皮佛莱格两座大型破火山口的活动序列进行了验证。该物理模型能有效识别地壳破裂前兆，为预测长期休眠火山的喷发风险提供了实用的定量工具。

t: An energy-balance method that tracks changes in stored elastic energy by calculating the difference between energy supplied by an underground pressure source and energy lost through local seismicity.
一种通过计算地下压力源输入的能量与本地地震释放能量之差来追踪弹性储能变化的方法。
Seismic and deformation (unrest) datasets from two major calderas: Sierra Negra (Galápagos) and Campi Flegrei (Italy).
来自塞拉内格拉（加拉帕戈斯）和坎皮佛莱格（意大利）两座大型破火山口的地震与形变活动数据集。
Successfully identified the onset of bulk fracture growth and crustal weakening, providing a practical procedure to recognize increased potential for volcanic rupture.
成功识别出整体裂缝生长和地壳弱化的起点，为识别火山破裂风险增加提供了实用的流程。

依赖于对流体压力源能量和地震能量损失的准确量化，这可能存在高度不确定性。
Shifts volcanic forecasting from empirical seismic rate thresholds to a physics-based energy balance tracking the onset of bulk crustal fracture growth.

sum: This paper introduces a scalable Bayesian framework for inferring modern-day sea-level change and surface mass redistribution. Addressing the systematic biases and underestimated uncertainties of standard methods, the authors combine three key advances: embedding full sea-level physics using adjoint theory, formulating the Bayesian inverse problem in an infinite-dimensional setting to avoid discretization artifacts, and utilizing matrix-free iterative solvers with randomized low-rank decompositions for computational tractability. Implemented in open-source Python libraries (pygeoinf and pyslfp), the framework allows complex joint inversions of satellite gravity and ocean altimetry data to be performed on a single laptop. Synthetic experiments demonstrate its ability to accurately decompose sea-level change into steric and manometric components with rigorous uncertainty quantification, overcoming traditional computational bottlenecks.

sum: This study investigates how fault roughness modulates the response of fluid-pressurized faults using an ensemble of 1,395 3D dynamic rupture simulations. By varying roughness wavelength, amplitude, and dynamic friction, the authors demonstrate that rupture propagation and arrest are governed by a competition between large-scale pore-pressure gradients and local geometric stress heterogeneities. Fault roughness promotes complex rupture behaviors, including acceleration/deceleration phases and pulse-like ruptures, even at the Mw~1 scale. The maximum roughness wavelength constrains rupture growth and maximum magnitude, resulting in bimodal magnitude distributions. Smoother faults favor coherent, crack-like propagation due to higher loading conditions at the rupture front. These findings highlight the necessity of accounting for both initial stress and fault geometric complexity to reliably estimate the maximum size of induced earthquakes.
本研究通过1395个三维动态破裂模拟，探讨了断层粗糙度对流体加压断层破裂的调制。结果表明，破裂传播与停止取决于孔隙压力梯度与局部几何应力非均匀性的竞争。断层粗糙度在Mw~1级微震尺度上即可诱发复杂破裂，其最大波长限制了破裂增长和最大震级。该研究强调了评估诱发地震最大震级时考虑断层几何复杂性的重要性。

sum: This review synthesizes recent planetary exploration data, Martian meteorites, and InSight seismic observations to present a comprehensive model of the Martian crust and mantle. InSight data indicates an average crustal thickness of 49±7 km with an intracrustal discontinuity at 20–30 km depth, alongside a ~150 km-thick molten silicate layer (MSL) at the mantle's base. Geochemical mass-balance modeling shows the crust contains ~45% of highly incompatible elements. The paper integrates these geophysical and petrological constraints into a unified geodynamic model of Mars's differentiation and evolution.

sum: This study presents high pressure and temperature (up to ~5 GPa and 773 K) seismic velocity and PVT equation of state measurements of two natural monomineralic chlorite schists. The authors discover that chlorite exhibits an anomalously high Vp/Vs ratio, which increases to over 3 at 5 GPa and 773 K. This extremely high ratio implies that even a small volume fraction of chlorite can account for the high Vp/Vs anomalies (>1.8) observed in the mantle wedge of subduction zones, such as the Lesser Antilles. Consequently, high Vp/Vs ratios in these regions are not uniquely diagnostic of free fluids, providing a new framework for interpreting subduction zone seismological observations and volatile cycling.

sum: This study repurposes an unlit ('dark') telecommunication fiber-optic cable along Milford Road in Fiordland, New Zealand, into a distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) array to monitor snow avalanches during the 2024 winter and spring. By analyzing DAS data, the authors constrain the timings of 16 avalanches and detail two triggered and two natural events. They present the first seismic evidence of plunging dynamics in these avalanches, identify impulsive signals from the stopping phase, and detect a precursory signal in wet slab avalanches linked to water-saturated structure collapse. They also correlate avalanche occurrences with high precipitation rates. The study highlights dark-fiber DAS as a cost-effective, continuous monitoring tool for remote alpine hazards, while noting challenges like traffic noise interference.
本研究利用新西兰暗光纤构建DAS阵列，监测了2024年冬春季雪崩。研究确定了16次雪崩，首次提供其坠落动力学的地震学证据，并发现雪崩停止阶段的脉冲信号及湿雪崩前结构塌陷的前兆信号。研究还探讨了雪崩与降雨的关系，展示了暗光纤DAS在遥远高山灾害监测中的潜力，并指出交通噪声是主要干扰。

sum: This paper introduces a novel diagnostic framework to address parameter identifiability issues in nonstationary Epidemic Type Aftershock Sequence (ETAS) models. The method pairs penalized nonstationary ETAS inference (using empirical-Bayes and ABIC) with an independent, model-agnostic anomaly-detection analysis using an Isolation Forest algorithm. Applied to the aftershock catalog of the 2025 Mw 7.1 Dingri earthquake in southern Tibet, the ETAS inversion suggests time-varying background rates and triggering productivity peaking 8–10 days post-mainshock. However, the Isolation Forest detector finds no coherent anomaly during this period. Semi-synthetic experiments confirm the detector's sensitivity to temporal-rate changes, suggesting that the real catalog's inferred parameter variations may be artifacts of parameter trade-offs rather than physical processes. This highlights the importance of model-agnostic validation for nonstationary ETAS models.
本文提出结合非平稳ETAS与孤立森林异常检测的机器学习诊断框架。应用于2025年西藏定日Mw 7.1地震余震序列时，ETAS反演显示主震后8-10天参数显著变化，但孤立森林未检测到异常。半合成实验证实了检测器的敏感性，表明推断的参数变化可能源于参数权衡而非真实物理过程，强调了独立验证的必要性。

Aftershock catalog of the 2025 Mw 7.1 Dingri earthquake in southern Tibet, alongside semi-synthetic catalogs generated to test the detector's sensitivity to temporal-rate perturbations.

sum: This paper addresses biases in earthquake forecast model ranking caused by fat tails and out-of-range observations in log-likelihood evaluations. The authors develop a tail-aware evaluation framework using adaptive Gaussian kernel density estimation and test three strategies for handling out-of-range counts, finding power-law extrapolation to be the most robust. They implement this framework on the AoyuX platform to conduct an ~25-year (2000–2023) month-by-month pseudoprospective forecast experiment in the China Seismic Experimental Site (CSES). Comparing ETAS models with homogeneous and heterogeneous backgrounds across multiple resolutions and magnitude thresholds, they show that the heterogeneous ETAS model outperforms the homogeneous one in data-rich configurations. The study also provides a robust estimate of the productivity exponent (alpha = 0.83 ± 0.19), advancing statistically grounded earthquake forecast assessments.

sum: This paper reports on the first long-term deployment of Güralp Aquarius broadband ocean-bottom seismometers (OBS) by the Canadian National Facility for Seismological Investigations on the Laurentian Fan seismic zone. Deploying 12 OBS at ~4.5 km depth, the study recovered eight instruments with three months of high-quality data. The authors addressed the lack of GPS synchronization using ambient-noise cross-correlation to correct clock drift. They determined sensor orientations and tilt angles using teleseismic P-wave particle motion and noise-based transfer functions. Applying machine-learning phase pickers, they detected 17 local-to-regional earthquakes (up to ML 2.2). Additionally, they identified fin and blue whale vocalizations, demonstrating a hybrid double-difference method to track a blue whale over 58 km. This study highlights the capability of the new OBS facility for both tectonic and marine bioacoustic research.

sum: This study applies high-resolution passive-source reverse time migration to teleseismic P-wave receiver functions from a dense seismic array to image the Moho beneath the Datong Basin. The results reveal a segmented Moho with localized crustal thinning (38–39 km) compared to the regional average of ~40.5 km. Seismicity clusters along the southwestern basin-bounding normal faults where the Moho depth gradient is steep, indicating mechanical coupling between upper-crustal faulting and lower-crustal deformation. In the northeastern volcanic area, enhanced Moho conversion amplitudes and lower-crustal low-velocity anomalies suggest magmatic underplating. The study demonstrates that horizontal extension and magmatic modification dominate Moho evolution in different segments of the rift.

sum: The paper develops a simple quasi-static elastic model to investigate the physical mechanisms of slow earthquakes. By incorporating fault elements that are either slipping or locked (with healing-dependent static strength), the model successfully reproduces both the migration patterns of elastic/frictional models and the statistical properties of Brownian models. The simulated events exhibit characteristic recurrence intervals (~1 year), propagation speeds (~10 km/day), and high-frequency decay ($f^{-1}$) consistent with observations. The authors approximate the simulated moment rate functions using a linear birth-death process, providing analytical estimates of equilibrium moment rate and spectral properties. This model successfully bridges the gap between elastic/frictional and Brownian representations of slow slip.

sum: This study investigates the mechanical behavior of a compressed granular fault under slow shear using simultaneous measurements of torque, layer thickness, acoustic emission, and photoelastic force networks. The authors discover that granular avalanches do not always relax the system; instead, some events simultaneously dilate the layer and increase the elastic energy transmitted to the resisting boundary. This counterintuitive behavior is driven by the reorganization of force chains beyond the shear band, accompanied by a distinct acoustic signature. These findings challenge the traditional view of fault relaxation during slip events, suggesting that avalanches can redistribute stress into more highly loaded configurations, with significant implications for both laboratory and natural fault mechanics.
本研究通过同步测量扭矩、层厚、声发射和光弹性力网络，研究了慢剪切作用下压缩颗粒断层的力学行为。作者发现，颗粒崩塌并不总是释放系统能量；相反，某些事件在使介质膨胀的同时，还会增加传递到阻挡边界的弹性模能。这种反直觉的行为是由剪切带之外的力链重组驱动的，并伴随着独特的声发射特征。这些发现挑战了滑动事件期……

在压缩颗粒断层中同步测量扭矩、层厚、声发射和光弹性力网络。
Experimental data from a slowly sheared, compressed granular layer composed of photoelastic disks.
来自慢剪切、压缩光弹性圆盘颗粒层实验的物理数据。
Discovery of avalanches that simultaneously dilate the granular layer and increase the stored elastic energy transmitted to the boundary.

sum: This study investigates how submerged oceanic domains transform into stable continental interiors and its impact on the carbon cycle. Using coupled geodynamic subduction and landscape-evolution simulations, the authors show that uplift of surrounding orogenic belts creates strong topographic gradients. This drives intense erosion, sediment transport, and basin stabilization in Central Asia during the late Paleozoic. The resulting enclosed intracontinental basins exhibit high sedimentation rates, promoting efficient organic carbon burial and long-term sequestration. Despite offsets from oxidative weathering and metamorphic degassing, thick carbonate sequences indicate substantial net carbon sequestration. This coupling between deep Earth dynamics, surface erosion, and carbon burial amplified the late Paleozoic CO2 decline and global cooling, with similar processes potentially operating during Cenozoic Tethys closure.
本研究探讨了被淹没的洋区如何转变为稳定的陆内区域及其对碳循环的影响。通过结合俯冲地球动力学与地貌演化模拟，研究表明晚古生代中亚造山带的抬升产生了强烈的地形梯度，驱动了剧烈的侵蚀、泥沙输送和盆地稳定。这种构造格局形成了高沉积率的封闭式陆内盆地，促进了有机碳的高效埋藏和长期封存。尽管存在氧化风化和变质脱……

t: Coupled geodynamic simulations of subduction and landscape-evolution simulations of erosion and deposition.
结合了俯冲地球动力学模拟与侵蚀和沉积的地貌演化模拟。
Synthetic geodynamic and surface process models, validated by geological observations of Devonian-Carboniferous carbonate sequences.
合成地球动力学与地表过程模型，并结合泥盆纪-石炭纪碳酸盐岩地质观测进行验证。
Subduction-driven uplift and erosion create enclosed basins with high sedimentation rates, enhancing organic carbon burial and contributing to late Paleozoic global cooling.
俯冲驱动的抬升和侵蚀形成了高沉积率的封闭盆地，促进了有机碳埋藏并导致晚古生代全球变冷。
The model's simplified representation of oxidative weathering and metamorphic degassing, which partially offset carbon burial, requires further quantification.
模型中对部分抵消碳埋藏的氧化风化和变质脱气过程的刻画较为简化。
Identifies a surface-process-mediated pathway for ocean-to-continent conversion and carbon sequestration, linking deep Earth dynamics directly to long-term climate cooling.
发现了地表过程介导的洋陆转换与碳封存路径，将深部地球动力学与长期气候变冷直接联系起来。

kc: Identified an alternative, surface-process-mediated pathway for ocean-to-continent conversion in Central Asia.
Coupled geodynamic subduction models with landscape-evolution simulations to predict topographic gradients and erosion rates.

sum: This paper presents a Bayesian inversion framework to estimate effective parameters governing lateral and vertical CO2 migration in layered sandstone reservoirs. The authors develop a fast forward model based on a graph-based invasion-percolation (IP) approach, extending conventional IP to represent capillary-controlled filling and finite-rate transfer through shale barriers. Parameter estimation is performed using approximate Bayesian computation (ABC) and sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) sampling. The method is applied to real time-lapse seismic plume observations from the Sleipner CO2 storage project, successfully reproducing the CO2 distribution across nine sand units and its temporal redistribution from 2010 to 2023. Synthetic experiments demonstrate that monitoring data capturing breakthrough and post-breach redistribution provide the strongest constraints for forecasting. This computationally efficient framework enables rapid, repeated forecast revisions during active CO2 injection.
本文提出一种贝叶斯反演框架，利用快速图侵入渗流模型评估多层储层中二氧化碳运移参数。该模型表征了泥岩屏障下的充注与有限速率运移，并采用近似贝叶斯计算和序列蒙特卡洛进行推断。应用于Sleipner时移地震羽流数据，成功重现了2010-2023年间九个砂岩层中的二氧化碳分布。该方法计算高效，适用于活跃注入……

t: A fast graph-based invasion-percolation model representing capillary-controlled filling and finite-rate transfer, inverted using approximate Bayesian computation and sequential Monte Carlo sampling.
利用图侵入渗流模型表征充注与运移，结合近似贝叶斯计算和序列蒙特卡洛进行反演。
Real time-lapse seismic plume observations from the Sleipner CO2 storage project (2010–2023) and complementary synthetic datasets.

在快速贝叶斯反演框架内，扩展侵入渗流模型以表征穿过泥岩屏障的有限速率运移。

sum: This study develops a novel geometric framework to estimate Earth figure change (EFC) parameters, specifically the degree-2 zonal component representing the rate of change of the solid Earth's flattening, using global GNSS vertical velocity fields. By linking polar and equatorial radial deformation rates to this coefficient, the method evaluates gridding biases using synthetic GIA models and translates non-GIA elastic deformation into J2-rate contributions. Applying this framework to ITRF2014 and ITRF2020 vertical velocities from 1997 to 2015 reveals an accelerating flattening change, characterized by polar uplift increasing from ~0.5 to ~1.0 mm/yr and equatorial subsidence of similar magnitude. The inferred J2-rate shows a positive linear trend consistent with lower-latitude mass redistribution, demonstrating that GNSS vertical velocities provide a robust geometric complement to gravity-based assessments of global Earth figure change.
本研究开发了一种利用全球GNSS垂直速度场估算地球形状变化（EFC）参数（特别是表征固体地球扁率变化率的2阶带状系数）的新几何框架。该方法将极地和赤道平均径向形变率与该系数联系起来，利用GIA模型评估网格化偏差，并将非GIA弹性形变转化为对J2变化率的贡献。将该框架应用于1997-2015年ITRF……

t: A geometric framework linking polar and equatorial mean radial deformation rates to the degree-2 zonal coefficient of Earth figure change, incorporating GIA model corrections and elastic loading theory.

Global vertical velocity fields from ITRF2014 and ITRF2020 geodetic reference frames covering the period from 1997 to 2015, alongside synthetic GIA model datasets.

Polar uplift increased from ~0.5 to ~1.0 mm/yr with equivalent equatorial subsidence, indicating accelerating flattening change and a positive J2-rate trend from elastic loading.

The framework's accuracy is sensitive to gridding-related biases from uneven GNSS station distribution and relies heavily on the correctness of GIA models.

sum: This study investigates crustal anisotropy and deformation mechanisms in the southern South China Block (SCB) using receiver-function Pms splitting. Analyzing teleseismic waveforms from 250 broadband seismic stations (including 162 HAVESArray portable stations), the authors obtain reliable anisotropy parameters at 216 stations. The results reveal an overall WNW-ESE fast axis orientation (FAO) with significant regional variations. In the eastern Cathaysian block, NW-SE FAOs reflect tectonic extension from Paleo-Pacific subduction. In the Leizhou peninsula, a transition in FAO suggests horizontal flow from the Hainan mantle plume. The western Cathaysian block shows conjugate NW-SE and NE-SW FAOs linked to faulting and Indian plate subduction, while Hainan Island exhibits E-W FAOs aligned with major local faults. This work provides high-resolution constraints on crustal deformation in a complex tectonic junction.
本研究利用接收函数Pms分裂方法，分析了华南南部250个台站的远震波形，获得216个台站的壳内各向异性特征。结果显示，该区整体快轴方向为WNW-ESE，但区域差异显著：华夏东部受古太平洋俯冲伸展影响呈NW-SE向；雷州半岛记录了海南地幔柱水平流动；华夏西部受共轭断裂及印度俯冲影响呈双向特征；海南岛则……

该研究利用基于Pms分裂的接收函数方法分析远震波形，以测量地壳各向异性参数。

Reliable anisotropy results at 216 stations reveal an overall WNW-ESE fast axis orientation, with distinct regional variations reflecting Paleo-Pacific subduction, Hainan plume flow, and local faulting.

The Pms splitting method provides a vertically integrated measurement of crustal anisotropy, potentially masking depth-dependent variations within the crust.

sum: This study presents the first three-dimensional model of the crust and upper mantle beneath Tenerife Island (Canary Islands) using receiver function analysis. By analyzing teleseismic receiver functions, the authors image the deep seismic structure, identifying key features associated with the island's volcanic plumbing system. Specifically, the results reveal distinct zones of magma storage within the crust and evidence of magmatic underplating at the crust-mantle transition zone (Moho). These findings provide crucial constraints on the deep magmatic processes feeding the active Teide-Pico Viejo volcanic complex, improving our understanding of volcanic hazards and crustal growth in oceanic island settings.
本研究利用接收函数分析，构建了西班牙特内里费岛（加那利群岛）地壳与上地幔的首个三维深部结构模型。通过分析远震接收函数，研究团队成功对该岛的火山管道系统进行了成像，识别出地壳内部清晰的岩浆储集区以及地壳-地幔过渡带（莫霍面）处的岩浆底侵证据。这些发现为发育活跃的泰德-皮科维耶霍火山系统的深部岩浆补给过……

sum: This study evaluates various linear and non-linear dimensionality reduction techniques, including principal component analysis, manifold learning, and neural networks, on synthetic tsunami simulation data from the Nankai subduction zone. The simulations are based on earthquake rupture forecasts (ERFs) and linear long-wave Green's functions. Using external and internal metrics, the authors assess clustering performance for peak-nearshore tsunami amplitudes (PNTA) and time-series marigrams. Manifold learning methods achieved the highest clustering scores for PNTA profiles. Crucially, features extracted in the reduced domain can be mapped back to specific rupture zones along the fault, linking tsunami characteristics directly to earthquake source parameters. This work demonstrates the potential of non-linear dimensionality reduction for cluster-based downsampling in probabilistic tsunami inundation mapping.

sum: This study uses elastic full-waveform inversion (FWI) and geostatistical rock physics modeling to map and quantify subsurface water content in Yosemite National Park's Mariposa Grove. While shallow water (<2 m) is abundant near drainages, giant sequoias on hillslopes and ridges must access deeper rock moisture (>2 m) within weathered bedrock to avoid summer water stress. This suggests that sequoia root systems penetrate much deeper than previously assumed, highlighting the critical role of deep weathered bedrock moisture in sustaining these iconic trees during prolonged droughts.
本研究利用弹性全波形反演（FWI）和地质统计学岩石物理建模，对优胜美地国家公园巨杉林下的水分含量进行了定量测绘。结果表明，排水口附近2米以内的浅层水分充足，而山坡和山脊上的巨杉则必须获取2米以下风化基岩中的深层水分以避免夏季水分胁迫。这表明巨杉的根系比以往认为的更深，揭示了深层基岩水分在干旱季节维持……

sum: This study investigates the Marlborough Ultramafic Suite in the New England Orogen, Australia, using petrological and geochemical data to reconstruct the evolution of a once-consumed oceanic domain. The suite consists of harzburgite, serpentinite, and high-grade serpentinite, with major and rare earth element signatures resembling residual abyssal peridotites. Early lizardite serpentinization indicates seafloor fluid-rock interaction, while high bulk alkali/U ratios and prograde antigorite, talc, and magnesian olivine (Fo95) record subduction-related metamorphism. The authors propose that Paleo-Pacific oceanic lithosphere was subducted beneath eastern Gondwana, detached and mixed within the subduction channel, and subsequently exhumed and accreted. This work provides key constraints on the multi-stage evolution and recycling of subducted oceanic mantle.
本研究利用岩石地球化学数据分析了澳大利亚Marlborough超基性岩套。该岩套元素特征类似深海残留橄榄岩，其早期蜥蛇纹石化指示洋底流体作用，而顺变变质矿物（富镁橄榄石Fo95）记录了俯冲变质。结果表明该岩套在俯冲通道中脱离、混合并折返吸积，重建了古太平洋板块俯冲地幔的多阶段演化历史。

sum: This study investigates the temporal evolution of the magma plumbing system beneath La Palma, Canary Islands, by analyzing clinopyroxene crystals from the 1712, 1971, and 2021 eruptions. Using trace element mapping, thermobarometry, and cluster analysis, the authors identify a persistent, evolved phonolitic crystal mush in the upper mantle (~18–25 km depth, 1000–1025 °C). Prior to each eruption, hot basanitic recharge (1100–1150 °C) intruded and recycled this mush at least one week before magma ascent, occasionally stalling in the shallow crust. This reveals that upper-mantle evolved mushes are common in ocean island volcanoes and that mafic recharge is essential for unlocking them, providing critical constraints for interpreting volcanic unrest.
本研究分析拉帕尔马岛三次喷发的单斜辉石以探讨岩浆管道演化。结合微量元素制图与温压计，发现上地幔深部（18-25 km）存在常态化响岩质晶粥。喷发前至少一周，高温碧玄质岩浆注入并活化该晶粥以促进上升。这表明上地幔演化晶粥在洋岛火山中很常见，基性补给是解锁晶粥的关键，为火山活跃信号解释提供了重要约束。

sum: This study investigates the relationship between oil extraction activities and seismicity in the Qarun oil field, located west of the Dahshour earthquake source near Cairo, Egypt. Utilizing both geodetic (surface deformation) and seismological data from 2000 to 2010, the authors analyze the increased seismicity and surface deformation in the region. The findings suggest that the seismicity in the Qarun oil field is triggered, potentially influenced by local stress changes from reservoir activities and regional tectonic events like the Dahshour earthquake. This case study highlights the importance of integrating geodetic and seismic monitoring to understand induced and triggered seismicity in active oil reservoirs.

sum: This study develops empirical ground-motion models for the effective amplitude spectra (EAS) and group delay time (derived from Fourier phase spectra, FPS) in the Chilean subduction zone. Utilizing a comprehensive dataset of interface and inslab earthquake recordings (M 4.6 to 7), the authors employ Bayesian regression to characterize how spectral amplitudes depend on magnitude, distance, source type, and site conditions. The resulting models capture systematic phase variations and wave propagation characteristics, offering a spectrum-based alternative to traditional ground-motion models. This enables realistic time-history simulations for seismic hazard assessment and earthquake-resistant design in Chile.

sum: This study presents a novel geochronological age constraint for Guishandao, an active volcanic island located off northeastern Taiwan at the southern tip of the Okinawa Trough. By refining the eruptive history of Guishandao, the authors discuss its implications for the back-arc basin opening of the Okinawa Trough, regional tectonic evolution, geothermal energy potential, and volcanic hazard assessment. The new age data helps resolve previous chronological discrepancies, providing a more reliable framework for evaluating future volcanic risks and geothermal exploration in this tectonically active region.

sum: This study evaluates the capability of Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) networks for back-projection imaging of moderate earthquakes. Using synthetic tests and observations of a Mw 4.9 earthquake in the Eastern California Shear Zone, the authors demonstrate that the high spatial density of DAS arrays can resolve fine-scale, sub-kilometer cascading rupture features. They propose a novel two-step inversion procedure that integrates dense DAS observations with regional broadband seismic station data. This integration significantly enhances the spatiotemporal resolution of earthquake source imaging, offering a powerful tool to better understand rupture dynamics and seismic hazards using existing fiber-optic infrastructure.

sum: This study uses geodynamical modeling to investigate how the joint effects of water content and dense mid-ocean ridge basalt (MORB) fraction influence the density, viscosity, and stability of the mantle transition zone (MTZ). The authors find that the MTZ is dynamically stable only within a narrow range of MORB-to-water ratios. Outside this range, buoyancy-driven instabilities and dehydration occur. By combining these stability constraints with global MORB fraction estimates, the study shows that the MTZ's hydration potential is highly laterally heterogeneous and dynamically controlled. These findings align with observed water distributions, suggesting most of the MTZ is in stable or slowly dehydrating regimes, supporting a sustained deep water cycle.

sum: This study investigates the orientation of maximum horizontal ground-motion intensity in strike-slip earthquakes using both theoretical modeling and observational data. By analyzing theoretical displacements above a shear dislocation in an isotropic, homogeneous medium, the authors show that while maximum intensity generally aligns with the epicentral transverse orientation, it systematically shifts to the radial orientation in cones near the principal stress axes. This pattern is qualitatively confirmed using recorded waveforms, including filtered velocities, high-rate GNSS displacements, and oscillator responses from strong-motion and simulated accelerations. The findings challenge the assumption of a uniform transverse orientation across all azimuths and suggest that incorporating the angle from the fault strike as a predictor variable can significantly improve estimates of maximum intensity orientation for future seismic hazard analyses.

sum: This study presents the first fully automated, pseudo-real-time pipeline using prompt elastogravity signals (PEGS) for rapid earthquake source characterization in Alaska. Combining an automatic detection module, real-time waveform processing, and a PEGS-based deep-learning model, the system addresses the magnitude saturation issue of traditional seismic early warning. Evaluated using a 13-month continuous playback and 79 historical events (2018–2025), the pipeline successfully characterized three major regional earthquakes (including the Mw 8.2 Chignik event) within 90–120 seconds of onset. By enforcing a multiparametric alert criterion, the system achieved a zero false-alarm rate. While highly robust to timing errors, its sensitivity remains limited by network density. This module is currently running in real-time test mode with the Alaska Earthquake Center, offering a promising tool for rapid tsunami warning support.

sum: SW1D is an open-source Python package designed for the forward modeling of Rayleigh and Love wave dispersion curves as well as synthetic seismograms in 1-D elastic, isotropic, and laterally homogeneous media. It solves the surface wave eigenvalue problem using a propagator-matrix technique and computes frequency-domain excitations for point sources defined by moment tensors. The package is validated against established seismological software. SW1D is particularly useful for niche applications within Python-based workflows, such as modeling surface wave propagation across lateral discontinuities and forward modeling ambient noise cross-correlations with arbitrary source distributions.
SW1D是一个开源Python软件包，用于在一维弹性、各向同性且横向均匀的介质中前向模拟瑞利波和勒夫波的色散曲线及合成地震图。该软件采用传播矩阵技术求解面波特征值问题，并计算由矩张量定义的点源在频域中的面波激发。SW1D通过了理论分析验证，并与成熟地震学软件进行了基准测试。它适用于Python生态系……

sum: This study investigates the tectonic and thermal controls on megathrust earthquakes along the Sunda Arc. By integrating seismic observations, structural imaging, and thermal modeling, the authors analyze how variations in plate interface temperature, sediment thickness, and incoming plate topography influence the spatial distribution, rupture limits, and slip behavior of large megathrust events. The results highlight the critical role of thermal boundaries (e.g., the 100-150°C and 350-450°C isotherms) and structural heterogeneity in defining the updip and downdip limits of the seismogenic zone, providing key insights into earthquake hazard assessment along this highly active subduction zone.

sum: This paper presents a safety analysis of seismic reinforcement materials for port engineering, specifically focusing on early-strength mineral-based cementitious materials. The author combines laboratory dynamic triaxial tests with multi-scale numerical simulations using the OpenSees finite element platform. The dynamic properties of the material, such as shear modulus and damping ratio, are characterized under different curing agent dosages and confining pressures. A high-pile wharf numerical model is established to evaluate structural responses, and Monte-Carlo simulations are performed to calculate conditional failure probabilities under seismic loading. The results show that reinforcing the foot of the retaining wall significantly reduces residual displacement and pile strain, and a 2 m reinforcement depth dramatically lowers the probability of severe structural damage under strong ground motion (0.5 g).
本文针对港口工程抗震加固材料的安全性，结合室内动态三轴试验与多尺度数值模拟，研究了新型早强矿物基胶凝材料的动力性能。利用OpenSees有限元平台建立高桩码头数值模型，并结合蒙特卡洛分析计算了地震作用下的结构条件失效概率。结果表明，固化剂掺量为8%时材料具有高初始剪切模量；挡土墙墙趾为最佳加固位置，……

sum: This paper presents 'Eigenwave' theory, which extends the variational Eigenray method to finite-frequency wave propagation in heterogeneous anisotropic elastic media. By employing a trajectory-mechanics formulation, finite-frequency effects are incorporated via a frequency-dependent potential that couples phase and amplitude. This formulation represents wave propagation through an equivalent effective medium, introducing local corrections to ray trajectories, phase, amplitudes, and caustic behavior while reducing to classical ray theory at high frequencies. Numerical examples involving multipathing and cusp caustics demonstrate that incorporating a phase-space (Maslov) treatment successfully reproduces finite-difference wavefield solutions, establishing a unified framework connecting ray and wave theories.
本文提出特征波理论，将变分特征射线方法扩展至各向异性介质的有限频率波传播。该方法基于轨道力学，通过频率相关势函数耦合相位与振幅，在等效介质框架下引入射线轨迹、相位和振幅的局部修正。数值算例表明，结合Maslov相空间处理能成功重现有限差分波场解，建立了连接射线与波动理论的统一框架。

sum: This paper presents a neural-network-based framework for the sequential estimation of time-dependent seismic b-values. Because true b-values are unknown in real catalogs, the model (based on bidirectional long short-term memory, BiLSTM) is trained on synthetic catalogs generated by epidemic-type aftershock sequence (ETAS) simulations with prescribed piecewise-linear b-value variations. The model maps earthquake magnitude sequences directly to b-value sequences, achieving lower root-mean-square errors than conventional moving-window maximum-likelihood estimation (MLE). It suppresses spurious short-timescale fluctuations while maintaining adaptability to abrupt changes. When applied to the 2011 Tohoku earthquake sequence, the model successfully captures a gradual pre-mainshock decrease in b-value, offering smoother sequential estimates.
本文提出了一种基于神经网络的地震b值随时间变化顺序估计框架。由于真实地震目录中的真实b值未知，该方法利用流行病型余震序列（ETAS）模拟生成的合成目录进行训练，其中b值被设定为分段线性变化。该模型基于双向长短期记忆网络（BiLSTM），直接将地震震级序列映射为对应的b值序列。相比于传统的滑动窗口极大……

sum: This study presents the largest high-precision 142Nd dataset for a single hotspot, analyzing 29 Hawaiian shield-stage tholeiitic basalts. Complemented by 138Ce and 143Nd data, the results show no significant 142Nd variability (weighted mean 0.48 ± 0.27), remaining indistinguishable from reference materials and global ocean island basalts. This lack of anomaly indicates that the depleted mantle source of these lavas formed later than ~400 Ma after Solar System formation. Consequently, the data do not support the preservation of early-formed, primordial Sm-Nd isotopic heterogeneities in the deep mantle beneath Hawaii, despite the presence of seismically anomalous low-velocity zones. This highlights a discrepancy with other isotopic systems (e.g., 182W, 100Ru) and underscores the complexity of deep mantle reservoir preservation.
本研究提供了夏威夷热点最大规模的高精度142Nd数据集（29个样品，55次分析）。结果显示样品无显著142Nd异常（均值0.48 ± 0.27），与全球洋岛玄武岩一致。这表明其亏损地幔源区形成于太阳系形成约400 Ma之后。尽管该区存在地震低速异常，但新数据未支持深部地幔保留早期原始Sm-Nd同位素……

t: High-precision thermal ionization mass spectrometry (TIMS) combined with multiple chemical purification procedures to measure short-lived and long-lived radiogenic isotope systems.
采用高精度热电离质谱（TIMS）与多种化学纯化流程，测量短寿命和长寿命放射性同位素系统。

Hawaiian basalts show no significant 142Nd variability (weighted mean 0.48 ± 0.27), indicating their depleted mantle source formed later than ~400 Ma after Solar System formation.

sum: This study analyzes P- and S-wave travel-time characteristics and station-dependent residuals using local earthquakes from the Ghana Digital Seismic Network (GHDSN) recorded between 2012 and 2014. Using first-order linear regressions on 47 station-level P+S observations from nine selected earthquakes, the authors determine effective velocities of 6.51 km/s for P waves and 3.88 km/s for S waves. Permutation tests reveal statistically significant station-associated travel-time variability, though its overall magnitude is limited. This work provides an empirical baseline for local seismic-wave propagation in southern Ghana and highlights the need for future joint velocity-location-station inversions.
本研究利用加纳数字地震台网（GHDSN）2012-2014年记录的本地地震，分析了P波和S波的走时特征及台站相关残差。通过对9个地震的47个台站级P+S观测数据进行一阶线性回归，确定P波和S波的有效速度分别为6.51 km/s和3.88 km/s。置换检验表明存在统计学上显著的台站相关走时变化，尽管……

sum: RiptideRemix is an interactive web dashboard developed during the 2025 Ocean Hack Week to synthesize musical compositions from marine acoustic and geophysical datasets. By integrating pre-processed audio clips from sources like Ocean Networks Canada (ONC), SAGE, OrcaSound, and NCEI, the toolbox allows users to manipulate pitch, speed, and repetition in a visual audio mixer. The platform generates waveforms, spectrograms, and whimsical maps representing the sound sources. Beyond its creative utility, RiptideRemix serves an educational purpose by providing detailed descriptions of marine sensors, environments, and seismic wave physics, making complex geophysical data accessible and engaging to the public.
RiptideRemix是2025年海洋黑客周开发的交互式网页工具，利用海洋声学和地球物理数据合成音乐。该工具整合了ONC、SAGE、OrcaSound和NCEI的音频，允许用户在混音器中调整音高和速度，并生成波形与声谱图。项目还包含科普板块，介绍海洋传感器和地震波物理学，以寓教于乐的方式向公众推广……

sum: This study investigates the recent volcanic history and magmatic processes of the Gumat Mali and Gablaytu sub-segments in the southern Manda Hararo rift, Ethiopia. Using high-resolution Pléiades imagery, volcanological mapping, major/trace element geochemistry, and cosmogenic 36Cl surface exposure dating, the authors constrain the youngest eruptions to ~3.20–1.50 ka (Gablaytu) and ~1.90–0.61 ka (Gumat Mali). Petrological modeling indicates that Gumat Mali was fed by reservoir recharge and magma hybridization, whereas Gablaytu experienced progressive differentiation and plagioclase assimilation. These findings reveal a complex, vertically connected transcrustal plumbing system and highlight distinct magmatic behaviors within closely spaced rift sub-segments, with important implications for regional volcanic hazard assessment.
本研究结合高分辨率Pléiades卫星图像、火山地质填图、主微量元素地球化学及宇宙成因核素36Cl地表暴露定年，系统研究了埃塞俄比亚Manda Hararo裂谷南部两个子段的最新火山活动历史。结果表明，Gablaytu和Gumat Mali子段的最新喷发分别发生于约3.20-1.50 ka和1.90……

Youngest eruptions occurred at Gablaytu (~3.20-1.50 ka) and Gumat Mali (~1.90-0.61 ka), driven by distinct magma recharge and differentiation processes in a transcrustal plumbing system.

sum: This study investigates the mechanical conditions controlling "flip-flop" detachment faults at amagmatic ultraslow mid-ocean ridges using 2D thermo-mechanical models. By incorporating self-evolving thermal structures, Mohr-Coulomb elasto-plasticity, and fluid circulation, the authors identify three deformation regimes: distributed minor faults, sequential flip-flop detachments, and persistent runaway detachments. Flip-flop detachments, where faults periodically alternate polarity, occur under moderate frictional (friction coefficient ~0.2-0.3) and cohesive weakening, which can be achieved via fault-zone serpentinization. In contrast, runaway detachments require excessive weakening, and a strong viscous lower lithosphere suppresses detachment formation. Analytical force balance modeling confirms that flip-flop faulting occurs when fault strength loss balances the defocusing effect of lithospheric flexure. These findings provide a quantitative framework for understanding how modest rheological contrasts drive large-offset faulting at mid-ocean ridges.
本研究利用二维热-力学数值模拟，系统探讨了无岩浆超慢速洋中脊“交替（flip-flop）”拆离断层发育的力学控制机制。模型考虑了自演化热结构、摩尔-库仑弹塑性（伴随摩擦和凝聚力弱化）以及流体循环。研究识别出三种变形模式：弥散微断层、交替拆离断层和持续失控拆离断层。结果表明，交替拆离断层在适度的摩擦（……

t: 2D thermo-mechanical modeling incorporating Mohr-Coulomb elasto-plasticity with friction and cohesion weakening, self-evolving thermal structures, and parameterized fluid circulation.
结合摩尔-库仑弹塑性（摩擦与凝聚力弱化）、自演化热结构和流体循环参数化的二维热-力学数值模拟。
Synthetic numerical simulations of amagmatic ultraslow mid-ocean ridges under varying frictional and cohesive strength contrasts.
在不同摩擦和凝聚力强度对比下，针对无岩浆超慢速洋中脊的合成数值模拟。

sum: This study investigates present-day microseismicity within the Tsetserleg-Bulnay fault system in Mongolia, which hosted two Mw>8 earthquakes in 1905. Using 16 months of temporary seismic network data, the authors construct a catalog of 8,000 earthquakes (ML ≥ -0.6) to image the 3D geometry of the fault system. The spatial distribution and rate of seismicity suggest that current activity represents long-lasting aftershocks of the 1905 sequence. The seismicity rate aligns with Omori and Gutenberg-Richter predictions. Furthermore, rate-and-state models explain why the slowly slipping Tsetserleg fault exhibits higher microseismicity than the faster-slipping Bulnay fault. This demonstrates that aftershock sequences in slowly deforming continental regions can persist for over a century, providing crucial insights into historical ruptures and long-term fault behavior.
本研究利用16个月临时台网数据构建了蒙古1905年双8级地震断裂带的微震编目。结果表明，当前的微震是1905年地震的超长余震，衰减率符合Omori和G-R定律。速率-状态摩擦模型解释了为何慢划动的鹐鹐尔勒格断裂比快划动的布尔奈断裂微震更活跃，证实了缓慢变形大陆区余震可望持续百年以上。

t: Constructing a high-resolution microseismicity catalog using 16 months of temporary seismic network data and analyzing seismicity rates with Omori and Gutenberg-Richter relations.
利用16个月的临时地震台网数据构建高精度微震编目，并结合Omori和G-R定律分析地震活动率。

Seismicity delineates 3D fault geometry and represents long-lasting aftershocks of the 1905 sequence, with the slowly slipping Tsetserleg fault hosting more microseismicity than the faster Bulnay fault.

The study relies on a relatively short (16-month) observation window to characterize century-long aftershock processes.

sum: This paper presents a global 4D prestack seismic inversion method designed to address the ill-posedness of conventional prestack inversion. By representing the inversion model as a four-dimensional tensor spanning spatial and parameter dimensions, the method utilizes multi-dimensional matrix multiplication to construct the observed data. It incorporates multi-dimensional regularization to enhance stability and suppress noise. Furthermore, stratigraphic and fault constraints from seismic interpretation are integrated to ensure geological coherence. Synthetic and field data applications demonstrate that the method significantly improves robustness in complex structural areas while maintaining high computational efficiency.

sum: This paper proposes integrating wavelet transform methods directly into modern seismic imaging workflows, such as Least-Squares Migration (LSM) and Full Waveform Inversion (FWI), rather than using them solely for pre- or post-processing. By leveraging the multiscale, localized, and directional properties of wavelets, the authors develop techniques for wavelet-domain gradient conditioning, adaptive Hessian filtering for LSM, and Hessian-based preconditioning for FWI. Crucially, they introduce a wavelet-domain block Hessian inversion strategy for multi-parameter FWI, which successfully decouples parameter sensitivities (cross-talk) without heuristic reparameterization. Synthetic and field tests (using the Atlantis dataset) demonstrate accelerated convergence, reduced cross-talk, and superior image fidelity, establishing the wavelet transform as a powerful, scalable tool for next-generation seismic inversion.

sum: This study investigates the morphology of Large Low Velocity Provinces (LLVPs) in Earth's deep mantle using geodynamic modeling. While LLVPs are traditionally classified as either active rising superplumes or passive piles shaped by convection, recent seismic tomography models reveal plume-like shapes. The authors demonstrate that passive piles can exhibit a plume-shaped morphology when initialized with a hot isothermal temperature profile and small intrinsic density differences. This indicates that background mantle temperature and intrinsic density are critical controls on LLVP morphology. Consequently, the plume-like structures observed in seismic tomography do not uniquely imply active superplumes, as they can also be explained by passive piles with plume-shaped morphologies.

The novelty lies in demonstrating that halogen flux monitoring, due to high solubility in silicate melts, serves as a highly sensitive indicator of near-surface magma residence times and supply rate changes in basaltic volcanoes.

sum: This paper introduces a 4-D time-frequency-space-wavenumber (TFXK) objective function designed for Full-Waveform Inversion (FWI) using Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) data. Standard FWI often fails to resolve deep structures when strong, localized near-surface scattering dominates the wavefield. By explicitly enforcing spatial coherence across densely sampled DAS channels, the TFXK misfit suppresses shallow scattering and shifts adjoint kernel sensitivity toward deeper, larger-scale targets. The authors derive adjoint sources for both phase and envelope misfits and demonstrate, using a 2D synthetic FWI example with strong shallow heterogeneity, that the 4-D mapping smooths the objective function topology to mitigate local minima. The method also accommodates curved fiber geometries through advanced parameterizations, making it highly adaptable for real-world DAS and dense nodal array applications.

sum: This paper presents HypoNet Nankai PS, an upgraded hypocenter determination package that extends PINN-based travel-time inference to both P- and S-wave arrival times in a realistic 3D velocity model of the Nankai Trough. The authors constructed an S-wave velocity model from an existing P-wave model and revised the PINN training procedure (collocation points, architecture, optimizer) to handle steep S-wave travel-time gradients. Benchmark tests against the fast marching method showed reduced RMS deviations. Synthetic recovery tests and application to 223 earthquakes recorded by the DONET network off the Kii Peninsula demonstrated that the system provides rapid, accurate hypocenter locations. Seaward of the network, the estimated hypocenters are shallower than the JMA catalog, aligning with previous 3D relocations in the oceanic crust and uppermost mantle.

sum: This study introduces TM2DD, a workflow combining multistation template matching, automated correlation thresholds, cross-correlation phase refinement, and double-difference relocation. Applying TM2DD to five years of TexNet data in the Karnes Trough Fault Zone (Eagle Ford Shale, Texas) expands the earthquake catalog 17.5-fold. The relocated seismicity reveals that the 2023 M4.0 and 2025 M4.7 sequences ruptured adjacent fault segments with a 15-20 degree difference in dip. The deeper 2025 sequence exhibited mainshock-aftershock behavior, whereas the shallower 2023 sequence was swarm-like. All sequences correlate spatially and temporally with active hydraulic fracturing wells within 3.5 km. The novelty lies in the integrated, automated TM2DD workflow that successfully characterizes fine-scale fault structures and escalating hazard levels associated with hydraulic fracturing in a regional network setting.

sum: This study quantifies the hillslope displacement thresholds required to transition a rock mass from metastable to catastrophic failure (rock avalanche) during earthquakes. Using remote sensing measurements from six coseismic landslides in closely-jointed greywacke, the authors estimate normalized translational slope displacements (TSDs). They find that transitioning to the rock avalanche stage requires TSDs exceeding 5%, varying with hillslope angle. To generalize these findings, they propose the 'translational slope deformation index' (TSDI), which incorporates the translational angle and normalized displacement. This empirical tool bridges analytical slope displacement estimates with the probability of highly hazardous, mobile rock avalanches, improving coseismic landslide hazard assessments.

sum: This paper introduces Coseis-Diff, a novel error-correction model for single-frame coseismic InSAR interferograms based on a residual denoising diffusion framework with a diffusion transformer backbone. By leveraging global self-attention, the model overcomes the limited receptive fields of traditional CNNs, enabling unified correction of multi-scale errors (such as atmospheric delays, orbital errors, and decorrelation noise) without requiring external auxiliary data or time-series archives during inference. Evaluated on physics-based synthetic datasets and real-world earthquakes (Mw 5.7–7.05), Coseis-Diff successfully separates spatially correlated artifacts and recovers high-fidelity deformation signals. The results show excellent agreement with independent Okada dislocation models and GNSS displacements, offering a rapid, high-precision tool for emergency response and earthquake source inversion in data-scarce regions.

sum: This paper introduces SEQNet, a deep-learning seismic waveform denoising model that incorporates multiscale feature attention (MFA) and global feature aggregation (GFA) into a phase-sensitive time-frequency mask-reconstruction framework. Trained and tested on paired event-noise waveforms from the INSTANCE and STEAD datasets, SEQNet's architectural modifications are systematically evaluated. Ablation experiments show that MFA is the primary contributor to performance improvements. Compared to DeepDenoiser, SEQNet achieves superior reference-based waveform fidelity, whereas DeepDenoiser excels in event-to-pre-event contrast. A continuous data test on Lushan aftershocks demonstrates its practical utility for downstream phase picking. The study highlights the importance of distinguishing waveform fidelity from contrast enhancement in denoising evaluations.

sum: This paper introduces G2IFWI, a learned regularization framework that integrates a denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) into implicit full waveform inversion (IFWI) based on multiresolution hash encoding. To address the ill-posedness, cycle-skipping, and spurious high-frequency artifacts of traditional IFWI, the proposed method guides the inversion through joint optimization of the physics-based IFWI gradient and the score gradient from the diffusion prior. Well-log measurements can also be incorporated as local guidance. Tested on synthetic and short-offset field datasets, the framework significantly improves inversion stability, suppresses artifacts, and enhances reconstruction accuracy.

sum: This paper introduces the AI-Ready Downhole Microseismic Benchmark Database (AMBER), a curated dataset designed to overcome the lack of public training data for downhole microseismic AI applications. AMBER compiles waveforms from 10 downhole microseismic datasets, comprising over 4,000 events with more than 150,000 manually verified P- and S-wave arrival picks, alongside over 10,000 noise samples. Provided with Python tools for data ingestion and augmentation, AMBER serves as a standardized benchmark to stimulate and evaluate machine learning models for subsurface industrial monitoring, such as geothermal stimulation, carbon storage, and hydraulic fracturing.

sum: This paper derives a characteristic trajectory of the inelastic strain-rate field during fault preparation using a continuum damage constitutive law. It shows that while the mean strain rate increases monotonically, its spatial variance passes through a minimum during damage coalescence into a shear band. This variance minimum precedes the mean strain-rate maximum, distinguishing coherent localization from distributed acceleration. The authors introduce two seismicity-derived metrics—seismic strain dynamics (SSD) and the seismic regularity coefficient (dc)—as observational proxies for these strain-rate statistics. The model is validated across laboratory stick-slip experiments, dynamic rupture simulations, induced seismicity, and tectonic earthquakes, spanning eight orders of magnitude in scale.
本文基于连续介质损伤本构方程，推导了断层孕育过程中非弹性应变率场的特征轨迹。研究表明，随着损伤汇聚成剪切带，空间应变率均值单调增加，而其空间方差会经历一个极小值。该方差极小值先于均值极大值出现，从而将相干定位与分布式加速区分开。作者引入了地震应变动力学（SSD）和地震规则性系数（dc）作为这些统计量……

Laboratory stick-slip experiments, physics-based dynamic rupture simulations, induced seismicity, and tectonic earthquake catalogs spanning eight orders of magnitude.

sum: This study evaluates the starting point of the 2026 M7.1 Kumamoto earthquake in Japan relative to a prior forecast. Following the 2016 Kumamoto earthquake sequence, the authors identified a low b-value (slope of the earthquake size distribution) volume in the unruptured central Hinagu fault zone in 2019, suggesting it as the likely nucleation site for the next major event. The 2026 earthquake indeed initiated at 16 km depth within this low b-value zone, marking a rare successful advance identification of an earthquake's starting point. The rupture terminated at a fault bend characterized by persistently low b-values since 2000, which has now experienced increased Coulomb stress, highlighting this bend as the next critical hazard zone.
本研究评估了2026年日本M7.1熊本地震的起震位置。在2016年熊本地震序列后，作者于2019年指出日奈久断裂带未破裂中部存在低b值（地震震级分布斜率）区域，并预测其为下一次破裂的起点。2026年地震确实在16公里深度的低b值区边缘起震，实现了对大震起震点的提前预测。破裂最终止于自2000年以来持……

sum: This paper introduces a simple, low-cost tool that evaluates near-field tsunami evacuation feasibility by combining mobile-app GPS tracks from drills with simulated tsunami inundation. Applied as a proof of concept in Viña del Mar, Chile, the study analyzed 119 GPS trajectories under three departure times (0, 8, and 12 minutes post-earthquake). Results show that evacuation success drops drastically from 100 feasible trajectories at 0 minutes to only 3 at 12 minutes. The novelty lies in using real citizen-science GPS data from drills overlaid on dynamic inundation models to produce intuitive, time-dependent evacuation visualizations, offering an accessible alternative to data-intensive and expensive evacuation modeling for resource-limited communities.
本文提出一种低成本工具，将手机记录的演练GPS轨迹与海啸淹没模拟结合，评估近场海啸疏散可行性。在智利的应用表明，疏散成功率随延迟出发急剧下降，从0分钟的100条可行降至12分钟的3条。该方法创新地将真实演练数据与动态淹没模型叠加生成直观视频，为资源有限社区提供易推广的防灾评估与宣传工具。

sum: This paper presents a low-frequency structure-guided 3D conditional diffusion method for reconstructing missing seismic data, particularly consecutively missing traces. The method first extracts and completes stable low-frequency components from incomplete 3D seismic volumes using 3D structure-tensor dip estimation and event-oriented interpolation. This completed low-frequency volume serves as a structural constraint for a 3D conditional diffusion process. A 3D U-Net denoiser, enhanced by an optional lightweight 3D attention module, progressively restores mid- and high-frequency reflection details during reverse sampling. Tested on SEG C3 synthetic data and field datasets, the method effectively recovers complex 3D wavefield structures and improves lateral coherence compared to conventional and standard deep-learning interpolation methods.
本文提出一种低频结构引导的三维条件扩散方法，用于重建连续缺失的地震数据。该方法先通过结构张量倾角估计和插值补全低频成分作为结构约束，再利用结合注意力机制的3D U-Net在扩散反向采样中恢复中高频细节。在SEG C3等数据集上的测试表明，该方法能有效恢复复杂三维波场并提高横向连续性。

sum: This study presents a deep learning approach to classify local earthquakes and shallow borehole explosions by combining seismic scalograms with phase detection probabilities. The authors test one-branch (scalogram only) and two-branch (scalogram + P/S phase probabilities from a pre-existing model) CNN designs across 16 local datasets. The optimized two-branch model achieves 95.7% single-station balanced accuracy for in-distribution tests and improves out-of-distribution generalization accuracy to 87.6% (a 3.2% increase over the one-branch model). It also outperforms traditional P/S amplitude ratio discrimination by 14% on average. The novelty lies in incorporating pre-existing phase detection probabilities as auxiliary context, which reduces model parameters by half, speeds up training convergence, and significantly enhances classification performance in unseen regions.

sum: This paper addresses inconsistencies in existing scalar representations of geodetic strain rate tensors used to estimate seismic moment rates. The author proposes new definitions motivated by fault kinematics: strike-slip strain rate (e_s), total strain rate (e_t), and a style parameter representing the fractional dilatational contribution. Additionally, a new moment rate formulation (M_split) is introduced that partitions strike-slip and dilatational contributions onto separate strike-slip and dip-slip faults. Applying these measures to the southwestern United States reveals that in mixed-faulting regions (53% of the area), M_split exceeds the traditional minimum moment rate (M_min) by up to 34% (with a theoretical maximum of 37%). This demonstrates that kinematic mode decomposition provides more physically consistent and regionally significant estimates for seismic hazard assessment.

sum: This study investigates the crustal and lithospheric structure of Bangladesh using 3D gravity inversion constrained by seismic Moho depths, alongside 3D flexural backstripping. The results show Moho depths of 22–32 km and crustal thicknesses under 22 km in the Bengal Basin. The lithospheric structure reveals depth-dependent extension, with lithospheric thinning preceding crustal thinning in the north, while occurring synchronously in the south. The study identifies 5–8 km of magmatic underplating beneath the volcanic rifted margin. Flexural backstripping indicates 5–7 km of thermal subsidence in the Bengal Basin and tectonic uplift of the Shillong Plateau (~1 km from plume magmatism and sediment loading, with the rest from Cenozoic shortening). This provides a comprehensive geodynamic model for the region's evolution.

sum: This paper develops empirical parameterisations of the Japanese Meteorological Agency seismic intensity (IJMA) using ridge regression on 21,354 ground motion recordings from 112 Japanese earthquakes (1997–2025). The authors present a parsimonious three-parameter model combining peak ground acceleration (PGA), Sa(0.3 s), and Sa(1.0 s) that outperforms existing conversions by reducing uncertainty and bias. When applied to a synthetic parametric insurance portfolio, this model significantly reduces basis risk, enabling more reliable and transparent pricing for earthquake insurance.

sum: This paper presents a method to detect the oceanic Moho using teleseismic P-wave coda autocorrelations from Ocean Bottom Seismograph (OBS) records. By utilizing the reverberations (coda) of teleseismic P-waves, the method overcomes the high-noise environment of the ocean floor to image the crust-mantle boundary (Moho). This approach provides a valuable passive-source tool for constraining oceanic crustal thickness and lithospheric structure in marine environments where active-source seismic profiles are unavailable. The novelty lies in applying single-station P-wave coda autocorrelation specifically to OBS data to resolve the shallow oceanic Moho despite challenging noise conditions.

sum: This paper presents a lightweight convolutional neural network (CNN) to extract formation shear-wave velocity from quadrupole acoustic logging-while-drilling (LWD) array waveforms. Instead of traditional slowness-time coherence (STC) processing, which is computationally heavy and prone to noise, the proposed CNN directly regresses the inter-receiver moveout. Evaluated on a synthetic dataset, the model achieves a median relative velocity error of 2.51% ± 0.16%. It operates 25 times faster than vectorized STC and has a compact size of 266 KB, making it highly suitable for real-time downhole edge deployment. The study also explores the limits of supervised regression using STC-labeled logs, highlighting the risk of near-neighbor data leakage in random splitting.
本文提出一种轻量级CNN，直接从随钻四极子声波测井阵列波形中回归接收器间时差，以提取剪切波速度。在合成数据集上，该模型实现了2.51%的平均相对速度误差。模型大小仅266 KB，运行速度比传统STC方法快25倍，适合井下实时边缘部署。研究还通过深度阻断交叉验证揭示了传统随机划分中的数据泄漏风险。

sum: This study investigates regional variations in crustal seismic velocity susceptibility (dv/v) to earthquake shaking along the Alaska subduction zone. Analyzing 14 major earthquakes (Mw 6.8–8.2) using single-station coda-wave interferometry, the authors find significant dv/v drops at ~40% of stations for peak ground velocities (PGV) >1 cm/s. The highest susceptibility (largest dv/v drop per unit PGV) occurs near active volcanoes (e.g., Akutan, Katmai), whereas Cook Inlet basin sites show large drops primarily due to amplified PGV. Frequency-dependent analysis indicates these velocity changes are concentrated in the upper 500 meters, likely driven by hydrothermal systems and weakly consolidated volcanic rocks. This highlights the role of shallow volcanic structures in modulating seismic susceptibility.

sum: This paper presents an adaptive-tempered sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) procedure for joint Bayesian estimation of hierarchical geological uncertainties (metaparameters and cell-by-cell properties) in subsurface flow systems. Using noncentered parameterizations, flow surrogates, and blockwise MCMC mutation, the method is applied to 3D systems including a faulted carbon storage reservoir and a channelized oil-water system. It achieves close agreement with reference MCMC results while providing 2.5–7.0x speedups.

sum: This paper presents the design and unshielded validation of a three-axis vector optically pumped magnetometer (OPM) optimized for long-term stability in geomagnetic monitoring. Utilizing a buffer-gas-free rubidium vapor cell, a VCSEL, and direct absorption spectroscopy (DAS) for active frequency stabilization, the system overcomes thermal wavelength drift and wall-collision relaxation without complex sub-Doppler optics. Tested in an unshielded laboratory in Okayama, the OPM successfully tracked horizontal geomagnetic variations and resolved regional Parkinson induction vectors (reflecting the geomagnetic coast effect) despite DC railway interference. It achieves an intrinsic white noise floor of 10-20 pT above 1 Hz and a bias instability of 0.1 nT at 100-200 s. This work demonstrates a low-cost, high-stability OPM platform suitable for unshielded geophysical surveys.
本文研发了一种用于无屏蔽地磁监测的长期稳定三轴矢量光泵磁力仪。系统采用无缓冲气体铷气室，利用直接吸收光谱频率锁定克服激光漂移。在冈山无屏蔽环境下的测试表明，该仪器能准确追踪地磁变化并解析出反映区域电导率对比的帕金森感应矢量，白噪声达10-20 pT，为地球物理调查提供了低成本、高稳定的磁测平台。
